清净道论
The Path of Purification
觉音造
buddhaghosa
~Naa.namoli比丘英譯


# 【清净道论·序品】

南无婆伽梵·阿罗汉·三藐三菩陀
Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammaa-sambuddhassa


序论
Nidaana-aadikathaa

经中这样说。
住戒有慧人，修习心与慧，
有勤智比丘，彼当解此结。
“When a wise man, established well in virtue,
Develops consciousness and understanding,
Then as a bhikkhu ardent and sagacious
He succeeds in disentangling this tangle” (S I 13).
This was said. 

为什么要这样说呢？
But why was it said? 
据说：世尊在舍卫城时，
While the Blessed One was living at Saavatthii,

于夜分中，来一天子，
it seems, a certain deity came to him in the night, 
为除自己的疑惑，提出这样的问题：
and in order to do away with his doubts, he asked this question:
内结与外结，人为结缚结，
瞿昙我问汝，谁当解此结？
“The inner tangle and the outer tangle-
This generation is entangled in a tangle.
And so I ask of Gotama this question:
Who succeeds in disentangling this tangle?” (S I 13).


这问题的大意是：
2.Here is the meaning in brief. 
“结”是缔结，与爱网同义。
Tangle is a term for the network of craving. 
因为上下于色等所缘境界而屡屡生起爱着，
For that is a tangle in the sense of lacing together, 
犹如竹丛中的竹枝纠缠而称为枝网，故名为结。
like the tangle called network of branches in bamboo thickets, etc., because it goes on arising again and again up and down among the objects [of consciousness] beginning with what is visible.
因为对于自物他物，或于自身他身，或于内处及外处而生爱着，故说“内结与外结”。
But it is called the inner tangle and the outer tangle because it arises [as craving] for one’s own requisites and another’s, for one’s own person and another’s, and for the internal and external bases [for consciousness]. 
以如是生起爱着，故说“人为结缚结”。
Since it arises in this way, this generation is entangled in a tangle. 
譬如竹丛为枝结所缠，一切有情为爱网所缠结，
As the bamboos, etc., are entangled by the bamboo tangle, etc., 
这便是人被结缠、缠缚、缔结的意思。
so too this generation, in other words, this order of living beings, is all entangled by the tangle of craving-the meaning is that it is intertwined, interlaced by it. 
由于这个结的问题，所以“瞿昙我问汝”。
And because it is entangled like this, so I ask of Gotama this question, that is why I ask this. 
瞿昙是称呼世尊的姓。
He addressed the Blessed One by his clan name as Gotama. 
“谁当解此结”，
Who succeeds in disentangling this tangle: 
是问谁能解此缠缚于三界之内的坚牢之结。
who may disentangle this tangle that keeps the three kinds of existence entangled in this way? What he asks is, who is capable of disentangling it?


天子这样问了之后，
3.However, when questioned thus, 
那位于诸法中得无碍智行者、
the Blessed One, whose knowledge of all things is unimpeded, 
天中之天、
deity of deities, 
帝释中之胜帝释、
excelling Sakka (Ruler of Gods), 
梵天中之胜梵天、
excelling Brahmaa, 
证四无畏、
fearless in the possession of the four kinds of perfect confidence, 
具十力、
wielder of the ten powers, 
得无障智及慧眼的世尊，
all-seer with unobstructed knowledge, 
为答此义而说此偈：
uttered this stanza in reply to explain the meaning:
住戒有慧人，修习心与慧，
有勤智比丘，彼当解此结。
“When a wise man, established well in virtue,
Develops consciousness and understanding,
Then as a bhikkhu ardent and sagacious
He succeeds in disentangling this tangle.”


大仙（佛）所说之偈的戒等种种义，
现在我要如实的解释：
4. My task is now to set out the true sense, Divided into virtue and the rest,
Of this same verse composed by the Great Sage.
对于那在胜者（世尊）教中已得难得的出家，
There are here in the Victor’s Dispensation
Seekers gone forth from home to homelessness,
不得如实而知包摄戒等安稳正直的清净道，
And who although desiring purity
Have no right knowledge of the sure straight way
虽然欲求清净而精进，
可是不得到达清净的瑜伽者；
Comprising virtue and the other two,
Right hard to find, that leads to purity-Who, though they strive, here gain no purity.
我今依照大寺住者所示的理法，
为说能使他们喜悦极净决择的清净道。
To them I shall expound the comforting Path Of Purification, pure in expositions, Relying on the teaching of the dwellers In the Great Monastery; 
是故一切欲求清净者，
应当谛听我的恭敬说。
let all those Good men who do desire purity Listen intently to my exposition.


此中：“清净”，
是除了一切垢秽而究竟清净的涅槃。
5.Herein, purification should be understood as Nibbaana, which being devoid of all stains, is utterly pure. 
到达清净的道路为清净道。
The path of purification is the path to that purification; 
“道”，是至彼的方便。
The meaning is, I shall expound that path of purification.
这便是我现在要解说的清净道。
it is the means of approach that is called the path. 


有些地方，
6.In some instances 
清净道只是毗钵舍那（观）的意思。所谓：
this path of purification is taught by insight alone, according as it is said: 
“Formations are all impermanent:
一切行无常，若以慧观见，
得厌离于苦，此乃清净道。
When he sees thus with understanding
And turns away from what is ill,
That is the path to purity” (Dhp 277). 

有些地方，则作禅与慧的意思。所谓：
And in some instances by jhaana and understanding, according as it is said:
禅慧兼有者，彼实近涅槃。
“He is near unto Nibbaana
In whom are jhaana and understanding” (Dhp 372).


有些地方，则为业等的意思。所谓：
And in some instances by deeds (kamma), etc., according as it is said:
业与明及正法，戒与最上活命，
人依此等清净，不由姓与财净。
“By deeds, vision and righteousness,
By virtue, the sublimest life-
By these are mortals purified,
And not by lineage and wealth” (M III 262).


有些地方，则为戒等的意思。所谓：
And in some instances by virtue, etc., according as it is said:
一切戒圆具，有慧善等持，
精进勤勇者，渡难渡暴流。
“He who is possessed of constant virtue,
Who has understanding, and is concentrated,
Who is strenuous and diligent as well,
Will cross the flood so difficult to cross” (S I 53).


有些地方，是念住等的意思。所谓：
And in some instances by the foundations of mindfulness, etc., according as it is said: 
“诸比丘，有情的清净……作证涅槃的一乘之道，即四念住”。
“Bhikkhus, this path is the only way for the purification of beings … for the realization of Nibbāna, that is to say, the four foundations of mindfulness” (D II 290); 
四正勤等亦然。
and similarly in the case of the right efforts, and so on. 
但在这里，佛陀解答天子的问题，是以戒等的意义来显示的。
But in the answer to this question it is taught by virtue and the other two.


现在来略释本论最初的颂意：
7.Here is a brief commentary [on the stanza]. 
“住戒”，即安住于戒中。
Established well in virtue: standing on virtue. 
这里指圆满（受持）戒律的人而称为住戒者，
It is only one actually fulfilling virtue who is here said to “stand on virtue.” 
所以圆满戒律便是住戒的意义。
So the meaning here is this: being established well in virtue by fulfilling virtue. 
“人”是有情。
A man: a living being. 
“有慧人”，是由业生三因结生的慧，为有慧者。
Wise: possessing the kind of understanding that is born of kamma by means of a rebirth-linking with triple root-cause. 
“修习心与慧”，
Develops consciousness and understanding: 
是修习三摩地（定）和毗钵舍那（观）的意思。
develops both concentration and insight. 
这里是用“心”字来显示三摩地，
For it is concentration that is described here under the heading of “consciousness,” 
以“慧”字而名毗钵舍那。
and insight under that of “understanding.”
“有勤”，是有精进的人。
Ardent (aataapin): possessing energy. 
因为精进可以烧尽一切烦恼，故称为热（勤），
For it is energy that is called “ardour” (aataapa) in the sense of burning up and consuming (aataapana-paritaapana) defilements.
具此热力的人称为有勤。
He has that, thus he is ardent. 
“有智”，智名为慧，
Sagacious: it is understanding that is called “sagacity”; 
即具有那智慧的意思。
possessing that, is the meaning. 
这句（有智的智）是指含藏慧。
This word shows protective understanding. 
在解答问题的这个颂文里，曾有三次说到慧：
For understanding is mentioned three times in the reply to the question. 
第一（有慧人的慧）为生慧（生来的慧），
Herein, the first is naive understanding, 
第二（修习心与慧的慧）为观慧，
the second is understanding consisting in insight, 
第三（有勤智的智）是主导一切所作的含藏慧。
while the third is the protective understanding that guides all affairs. 
见轮回而生怖畏者为“比丘”。
He sees fear (bhaya.m ikkhati) in the round of rebirths, thus he is a bhikkhu. 
“彼当解此结”，“彼”，
He succeeds in disentangling this tangle: 
是具备此戒及由心字所显示的三摩地与三种慧和勤等六法的比丘。譬如一人立于大地上，举起最利的刀而斩除大竹丛一样，
Just as a man standing on the ground and taking up a well-sharpened knife might disentangle a great tangle of bamboos, so too, he-this bhikkhu who possesses the six things, namely, this virtue, and this concentration described under the heading of consciousness, and this threefold understanding, 
他则站于戒地上，以精进力策励于含藏慧之手，举起由定石磨得很利的观慧之剑，而解除斩断及摧毁使他自己（的诸蕴）相续沉沦的一切爱结。
and this ardour—standing on the ground of virtue and taking up with the hand of protective-understanding exerted by the power of energy the knife of insight-understanding well-sharpened on the stone of concentration, might disentangle, cut away and demolish all the tangle of craving that had overgrown his own life’s continuity. 
他在修（四沙门）道的刹那叫做解结；
But it is at the moment of the path that he is said to be disentangling that tangle; 
在证（四沙门）果的刹那，他便是天界和人界最上应供的解结者。
at the moment of fruition he has disentangled the tangle and is worthy of the highest offerings in the world with its deities. 
所以世尊说：
That is why the Blessed One said:
住戒有慧人，修习心与慧，
有勤智比丘，彼当解此结。
“When a wise man, established well in virtue,
Develops consciousness and understanding,
Then as a bhikkhu ardent and sagacious
He succeeds in disentangling this tangle.”


颂中所说“有慧人”的慧，不是现在所能造作的，
8. Herein there is nothing for him to do about the [naive] understanding on account of which he is called wise; 
那是由宿世业力所成就的。
for that has been established in him simply by the influence of previous kamma. 


“有勤”，是说常作精勤的人。“有智”，是有正智的行者。“心慧”，即止观。
But the words ardent and sagacious mean that by persevering with energy of the kind here described and by acting in full awareness with understanding he should, 

这便是说有勤智的比丘，既持戒而又修止观的意思。
having become well established in virtue, develop the serenity and insight that are described as concentration and understanding. 

当知在这一颂，世尊是用戒定慧三门显示清净道的。
This is how the Blessed One shows the path of purification under the headings of virtue, concentration, and understanding there.


进一层说，这颂也是阐明三学，
9.What has been shown so far is the three trainings, 
三种善教，
the dispensation that is good in three ways, 
为三明等的近依（强因），
the necessary condition for the threefold clear-vision, etc., 
避二边（极端）而行中道，
the avoidance of the two extremes and the cultivation of the middle way, 
超越恶趣等的方便，
the means to surmounting the states of loss, etc., 
以三相而断烦恼，
the abandoning of defilements in three aspects, 
违犯等的对治，
prevention of transgression etc., 
三杂染的净化，
purification from the three kinds of defilements, 
以及为须陀洹等的原因。
and the reason for the states of stream-entry and so on. 


怎样阐明的呢？
How?

## 一、（三学）这里的戒是阐明增上戒学；
10.Here the training of higher virtue is shown by virtue; 

定是增上心学；
the training of higher consciousness, by concentration;  

慧是增上慧学。
and the training of higher understanding, by understanding.

## 二、（三种善教）戒是阐明初善；
The dispensation’s goodness in the beginning is shown by virtue.
所谓：“何为初善法？
Because of the passage, “And what is the beginning of profitable things? 
即是极净戒”，
Virtue that is quite purified” (S V 143), 
又如“诸恶莫作”等语，
and because of the passage beginning, “The not doing of any evil” (Dhp 183), 
都是说明以戒教为首的；
virtue is the beginning of the dispensation. 
复次得无后悔之德故为善。
And that is good because it brings about the special qualities of non-remorse, and so on. 

定则阐明中善；
Its goodness in the middle is shown by concentration. 
如“众善奉行”等语，
Because of the passage beginning, “Entering upon the profitable” (Dhp 183), 
是说明定教为中；
concentration is the middle of the dispensation. 
又得有神变等德故为善。
And that is good because it brings about the special qualities of supernormal power, and so on. 

慧是阐明后善教；
Its goodness in the end is shown by understanding. 
如“自净其意，是诸佛教”等语，
Because of the passage, “The purifying of one’s own mind—this is the Buddhas’ dispensation” (Dhp 183), 
是说明以慧为最上及最后；
and because understanding is its culmination, understanding  is the end of the dispensation. 
又因那慧对于好恶的事物视为平等故为善。
And that is good because it brings about equipoise with respect to the desired and the undesired. For this is said:

所谓：
譬如坚石山，不为风所动，
毁誉不能动，智者亦如是。
“Just as a solid massive rock
Remains unshaken by the wind,
So too, in face of blame and praise
The wise remain immovable” (Dhp 81).


## 三、（为三明等的近依）戒是阐明为三明的近依（强因），
11.Likewise the necessary condition for the triple clear-vision is shown by virtue. 
因为只有依于戒的成就而得通达三明的。
For with the support of perfected virtue one arrives at the three kinds of clear-vision, but nothing besides that. 

定是阐明为六神通的近依，
The necessary condition for the six kinds of direct-knowledge is shown by concentration. 
因为只有依于定的成就而得六神通的。
For with the support of perfected concentration one arrives at the six kinds of direct-knowledge, but nothing besides that. 

慧是阐明为无碍解的近依，
The necessary condition for the categories of discrimination is shown by understanding. 
因为只有依于慧的成就而得达四无碍解，
For with the support of perfected understanding one arrives at the four kinds of discrimination, 
不是由于别的原固所成就的。
but not for any other reason.


## 四、（避二边而行中道）戒是阐明回避称为沉溺欲乐的极端行为。
And the avoidance of the extreme called devotion to indulgence of sense desires is shown by virtue. 

定是阐明回避称为自苦的极端行为。
The avoidance of the extreme called devotion to mortification of self is shown by concentration. 

慧是阐明行于中道之教。
The cultivation of the middle way is shown by understanding.


## 五、（超越恶趣等的方便）戒是阐明超越恶趣的方便。
12.Likewise the means for surmounting the states of loss is shown by virtue; 

定是超越欲界的方便。
the means for surmounting the element of sense desires, by concentration; 

慧是超越一切有的方便。
and the means for surmounting all becoming, by understanding.


## 六、（以三相而断烦恼）戒是阐明以彼分断而断烦恼，
And the abandoning of defilements by substitution of opposites is shown by virtue; 

定是以镇伏断而断烦恼，
that by suppression is shown by concentration; 

慧是以正断而断烦恼。
and that by cutting off is shown by understanding.


## 七、（违犯等的对治）戒是诸惑违犯的对治。
13.Likewise prevention of defilements’ transgression is shown by virtue; 

定是缠的对治，
prevention of obsession (by defilement) is shown by concentration; 

慧是随眠的对治。
prevention of inherent tendencies is shown by understanding.


## 八、（三杂染的净化）戒是阐明恶行杂染的净化。
And purification from the defilement of misconduct is shown by virtue; 

定是爱杂染的净化。
purification from the defilement of craving, by concentration; 

慧是恶见杂染的净化。
and purification from the defilement of (false) views, by understanding.


## 九、（为须陀洹等的原因）戒是阐明为须陀洹果及斯陀含果的原因。
14. Likewise the reason for the states of stream-entry and once-return is shown by virtue; 

定是阿那含果的原因。
that for the state of non-return, by concentration; 

慧是阿罗汉果的原因。
that for Arahantship by understanding. 

因为证得须陀洹的人称为戒圆满者，
For the stream-enterer is called “perfected in the kinds of virtue”; 
斯陀含果亦然。
and likewise the once-returner. 
证阿那含果的称为定圆满者。
But the non-returner is called “perfected in con-centration.” 
证阿罗汉果的称为慧圆满者。
And the Arahant is called “perfected in understanding” (see A I 233).

因为这样，故说此颂也是阐明
15.So thus far these nine and other like triads of special qualities have been shown, 
三学、
that is, the three trainings, 
三种善教、
the dispensation that is good in three ways, 
为三明等的近依、
the necessary condition for the threefold clear-vision, 
避二边而行中道、
the avoidance of the two extremes and the cultivation of the middle way, 
超越恶趣等的方便，
the means for surmounting the states of loss, etc., 
以三相而断烦恼、
the abandoning of defilements in three aspects, 
违犯等的对治，
prevention of transgression, etc., 
三杂染的净化，
purification from the three kinds of defilements, 
以及为须陀洹等的原因的九类并其他象这样的三德。这是序论。
and the reason for the states of stream-entry, and so on.
清净道论
The Path of Purification
觉音造
buddhaghosa
~Naa.namoli比丘英譯


# 【清净道论·第1品·说戒品】



第一说戒品
Discription of virtue

虽以如是包摄诸德的戒定慧三门而显示清净道，
16.However, even when this path of purification is shown in this way under the headings of virtue, concentration and understanding, each comprising various special qualities, 
但太简略，
it is still only shown extremely briefly. 
为了饶益一切（众生）是不够的，
And so since that is insufficient to help all, 
所以再加详细叙述。
there is, in order to show it in detail, 
这里先设些关于戒的问题：
the following set of questions dealing in the first place with virtue:


## 一、什么是戒？
(i) What is virtue?

## 二、什么是戒的语义？
(ii) In what sense is it virtue?

## 三、什么是戒的相、味、现起、足处？
(iii) What are its characteristic, function, manifestation, and proximate cause?

## 四、什么是戒的功德？
(iv) What are the benefits of virtue?

## 五、戒有几种？
(v) How many kinds of virtue are there?

## 六、什么是戒的杂染？
(vi) What is the defiling of it?

## 七、什么是净化？
(viii) What is the cleansing of it?


解答如下：
17.Here are the answers:

## 一、什么是戒

什么是戒？
(i) WHAT IS VIRTUE? 
即离杀生等或实行于义务行者的思（意志）等之法。
It is the states beginning with volition present in one who abstains from killing living things, etc., or in one who fulfils the practice of the duties. 
《无碍解道》说：
For this is said in the Pa.tisambhidaa: 
“什么是戒？即
“What is virtue? 
思戒，
There is virtue as volition, 
心所戒，
virtue as consciousness-concomitant, 
律仪戒，
virtue as restraint, 
不犯戒”。
virtue as non-transgression” (Pa.tis I 44).


此中：完成不杀等或完成义务行者的思名为“思戒”。
Herein, virtue as volition is the volition present in one who abstains from killing living things, etc., or in one who fulfils the practice of the duties. 


离杀生等的离名为“心所戒”。
Virtue as consciousness-concomitant is the abstinence in one who abstains from killing living things, and so on. 


其次舍杀生等的七业道之思名为“思戒、
Furthermore, virtue as volition is the seven volitions [that accompany the first seven] of the [ten] courses of action (kamma) in one who abandons the killing of living things, and so on. 


“舍贪欲而离贪心住”等所表现的无贪、无嗔、正见之法名为“心所戒”。
Virtue as consciousness-concomitant is the [three remaining] states consisting of non-covetousness, non-ill will, and right view, stated in the way beginning, “Abandoning covetousness, he dwells with a mind free from covetousness” (D I 71).


“律仪戒”，当知有五种律仪：即
18.Virtue as restraint should be understood here as restraint in five ways: 
别解脱律仪，
restraint by the rules of the community (paatimokkha), 
念律仪，
restraint by mindfulness, 
智律仪，
restraint by knowledge, 
忍律仪，
restraint by patience, 
精进律仪。
and restraint by energy. 

这里“圆满具足别解脱律仪”，是说关于别解脱律仪。
Herein, “restraint by the Paatimokkha” is this: “He is furnished, fully furnished, with this Paatimokkha restraint. (Vibh 246)” 

“防护眼根，成就眼根律仪”，是“念律仪”。
“Restraint by mindfulness” is this: “He guards the eye faculty, enters upon restraint of the eye faculty” (D I 70). 

世尊对阿耆多说：世界一切的瀑流，念是他们的防御。我说诸流的防护，他们当以慧来遮。这是“智律仪”；
“Restraint by knowledge” is this: “The currents in the world that flow, Ajita,” said the Blessed One, “Are stemmed by means of mindfulness; Restraint of currents I proclaim, By understanding they are dammed” (Sn 1035);
关于正当的使用资具等也包括在这里面。
and use of requisites is here combined with this. 

其次“对寒暑忍耐”等的表述为“忍律仪”。
But what is called “restraint by patience” is that given in the way beginning, “He is one who bears cold and heat” (M I 10). 

“不容生起欲寻”等的表述为“精进律仪”；
And what is called “restraint by energy” is that given in the way beginning, “He does not endure a thought of sense desires when it arises” (M I 11); 
活命遍净戒也是包括在这里面的。
purification of livelihood is here combined with this. 


上面这五种律仪，
So this fivefold restraint, 
以及怖畏罪恶的善男子离其所遭的恶事，
and the abstinence, in clansmen who dread evil, from any chance of transgression met with, 
一切都是律仪戒。
should all be understood to be “virtue as restraint.”

“不犯戒”，即受持戒律之人的身口等不违犯于戒。
Virtue as non-transgression is the non-transgression, by body or speech, of precepts of virtue that have been undertaken.


这里解答关于什么是戒的问题。
This, in the first place, is the answer to the question, “What is virtue?” Now, 


其他的问题：
as to the rest-




## 二、什么是戒的语义
19.(ii) IN WHAT SENSE IS IT VIRTUE? 

戒为戒行的意思。
It is virtue (siila) in the sense of composing (siilana). 
为什么称为戒行？
What is this composing? 
即正持--
It is either a coordinating (samaadhaana),  
以身业等善持戒律而不杂乱的意思；
meaning non-inconsistency of bodily action, etc., due to virtuousness; 
或确持--
or it is an upholding (upadhaaraṇa), 
保持一切善法的意思。
meaning a state of basis (aadhaara) owing to its serving as foundation for profitable states. 
此二义实为通晓文字法者所允许的。
For those who understand etymology admit only these two meanings. 
然而也有人解释戒为头义及清凉等义的。
Others, however, comment on the meaning here in the way beginning, “The meaning of virtue (siila) is the meaning of head (sira), the meaning of virtue is the meaning of cool (siitala).”


## 三、什么是戒的相、味、现起、足处
20. (iii) Now, WHAT ARE ITS CHARACTERISTIC, FUNCTION, MANIFESTATION, AND PROXIMATE CAUSE? Here:


（相）戒虽有多种，唯戒行为相。
The characteristic of it is composing Even when analyzed in various ways,
犹如种种色，可见性为相。
As visibility is of visible data Even when analyzed in various ways.
譬如青黄等色，虽有种种区别，
Just as visibleness is the characteristic of the visible-data base even when analyzed into the various categories of blue, yellow, etc., 
而色处的特相总不出于可见性。
because even when analyzed into these categories it does not exceed visible-ness, 
同样的，戒虽有思等的种种区别，总不出于以正持身业等及保持善法的戒行为相，所以说戒之相为戒行。
so also this same composing, described above as the coordinating of bodily action, etc., and as the foundation of profitable states, is the characteristic of virtue even when analyzed into the various categories of volition, etc., because even when analyzed into these categories it does not exceed the state of coordination and foundation.


（味）摧毁诸恶戒，具足诸善德，作用成就义，是即名为味。
21.While such is its characteristic: Its function has a double sense: Action to stop misconduct, then Achievement as the quality Of blamelessness in virtuous men.
此戒能摧毁诸恶戒，是以作用之义为味；
So what is called virtue should be understood to have the function (nature) of stopping misconduct as its function (nature) in the sense of action, 
其次具诸无罪之德，是以成就之义为味。
and a blameless function (nature) as its function (nature) in the sense of achievement. 
然在相等之义的味，只可说作用或成就为味（不是食味等的味）。
For under [these headings of] characteristic, etc., it is action (kicca) or it is achievement (sampatti) that is called “function” (rasa-nature).


（现起、足处）智者说净为现起，
22. Now, virtue, so say those who know, Itself as purity will show;
解释惭愧为足处。
And for its proximate cause they tell The pair, conscience and shame, as well. 
所谓“身净、语净、意净”，这是说净为此戒的现起。
This virtue is manifested as the kinds of purity stated thus: “Bodily purity, verbal purity, mental purity” (A I 271); 
因为由净性的显现而取为状态故。
it is manifested, comes to be apprehended, as a pure state. 
智者曾说惭与愧为戒的足处。
But conscience and shame are said by those who know to be its proximate cause; 
足处是近因的意思；
its near reason, is the meaning. 
因为有惭愧才能产生及存续戒律，
For when conscience and shame are in existence, virtue arises and persists; 
如果没有惭愧便不能产生及存续戒律。
and when they are not, it neither arises nor persists.


当知这是戒的相、味、现起、足处。
This is how virtue’s characteristic, function, manifestation, and proximate cause, should be understood.



## 四、什么是戒的功德


什么是戒的功德？
23.(iv) WHAT  ARE  THE  BENEFITS  OF  VIRTUE? 
如获得无后悔等的种种功德。
Its benefits are the acquisition of the several special qualities beginning with non-remorse. 

经中说：“阿难，一切善戒具有无后悔的目的和功德”。
For this is said: “Aananda, profitable habits (virtues) have non-remorse as their aim and non-remorse as their benefit” (A V 1). 

又说：“诸居士，持戒者的具戒，得此五种功德。
Also it is said further: “Householder, there are these five benefits for the virtuous in the perfecting of virtue. 
云何五种？
What five? 
诸居士，具戒的持戒者，
Here, householder, one who is virtuous, possessed of virtue, 
因不放逸，得大财聚，
obtains a large fortune as a consequence of diligence; 
这是持戒者具戒的第一功德。
this is the first benefit for the virtuous in the perfecting of virtue. 
复次诸居士，具戒的持戒者，
Again, of one who is virtuous, possessed of virtue, 
得扬善名，
a fair name is spread abroad; 
这是持戒者具戒的第二功德。
this is the second benefit for the virtuous in the perfecting of virtue. 
复次诸居士，具戒的持戒者，
Again, whenever one who is virtuous, possessed of virtue, 
无论亲近一切团体大众、
enters an assembly, 
刹帝利众、婆罗门众、居士众、或沙门众，
whether of khattiyas (warrior-nobles) or brahmans or householders or ascetics, 
在接近之时，得无怖畏羞惭，
he does so without fear or hesitation; 
这是持戒者具戒的第三功德。
this is the third benefit for the virtuous in the perfecting of virtue. 
复次诸居士，具戒的持戒者，
Again, one who is virtuous, possessed of virtue, 
临命终时，得不昏昧，
dies unconfused; 
这是持戒者具戒的第四功德。
this is the fourth benefit for the virtuous in the perfecting of virtue. 
复次诸居士，具戒的持戒者，
Again, one who is virtuous, possessed of virtue, 
此身坏死之后，
on the breakup of the body, after death, 
得生善趣天界，
reappears in a happy destiny, in the heavenly world; 
这是持戒者具戒的第五功德”。
this is the fifth benefit for the virtuous in the perfecting of virtue” (D II 86). 


又如“诸比丘！若有比丘，愿为诸同梵行者所喜爱、欢悦、尊重、礼敬，彼当圆满一切戒”。这都是说始于喜爱欢悦等而终于漏尽的诸戒的功德。
There are also the many benefits of virtue beginning with being dear and loved and ending with destruction of cankers described in the passage beginning, “If a bhikkhu should wish, ‘May I be dear to my fellows in the life of purity and loved by them, held in respect and honoured by them,’ let him perfect the virtues” (M I 33). 
这便是无后悔等种种戒的功德，
This is how virtue has as its benefits the several special qualities beginning with non-remorse. 


更有：
24.Furthermore:
佛教给与善男子的住处，
除了戒，更无别的了，
戒德的分量，谁能说得尽呢？
Dare anyone a limit place On benefits that virtue brings, Without which virtue clansmen find No footing in the dispensation?
众生的垢秽，不是恒河、夜摩那河、沙罗婆河，亦非沙罗伐底河、阿羯罗伐底河，也不是摩西河、摩诃奈地河的流水，所能洗得清净的，唯有戒水能净有情的尘垢。
No Ganges, and no Yamunaa No Sarabhuu, Sarassathii, Or flowing Aciravatii, Or noble River of Mahii, Is able to wash out the stain In things that breathe here in the world; For only virtue’s water can Wash out the stain in living things.
不是带来有雨之云的凉风。亦非黄色的旃檀、首饰的明珠，也不是明月照射柔和的光辉，
No breezes that come bringing rain, No balm of yellow sandalwood, No necklaces beside, or gems Or soft effulgence of moonbeams,
能使此世众生热恼的安宁，
Can here avail to calm and soothe Men’s fevers in this world; 
唯有善护圣戒能使热恼究竟的清凉。
whereas This noble, this supremely cool, Well-guarded virtue quells the flame.
戒香不但顺风送，也得逆风熏，那里还能找到这样的香呢？
Where is there to be found the scent That can with virtue’s scent compare, And that is borne against the wind As easily as with it? 
为升天的阶梯，入涅槃的城门，
那里还有别的可以比拟戒的呢？
Where Can such another stair be found That climbs, as virtue does, to heaven? Or yet another door that gives Onto the City of Nibbaana?
国王虽然盛饰摩尼珠，不如行者以戒庄严的光辉。
Shine as they may, there are no kings Adorned with jewellery and pearls That shine as does a man restrained Adorned with virtue’s ornament.
戒能摧毁自责等的怖畏，具戒常生名望和笑颜。
Virtue entirely does away With dread of self-blame and the like; Their virtue to the virtuous Gives gladness always by its fame.
戒为诸德的根本，一切罪恶的破坏者，当知这是略说诸戒的功德。
From this brief sketch it may be known How virtue brings reward, and how This root of all good qualities Robs of its power every fault.

of restraint of sense faculties,

of purification of livelihood,

and that concerning requisites.


（五）（１）依制限遍净戒等有五种；
18.It is of five kinds as virtue consisting in limited purification, etc.; 
这在《无碍解道》里说过：
for this is said in the Pa.tisambhidaa:

virtue consisting in tranquillized purification” (Pa.tis I 42).

19.Likewise as 
断、
abandoning, 
离、

and non-transgression.


此中：（一）（一法）关于一种分类的意义，已如前说易知。
26. 1. Herein, in the section dealing with that of one kind, the meaning should be understood as already stated.

（二）（二法）关于二种分类的：
（１）（作持、止持）世尊说“此事应作”！这样制定给与照行的学处，便是“作持”（戒）；
2. In the section dealing with that of two kinds: fulfilling a training precept announced by the Blessed One thus: “This should be done” is keeping; 
又说“此事不应作”！那样禁止不作的，便是“止持”（戒）。
not doing what is prohibited by him thus: “This should not be done” is avoiding. 
其语义如下：
Herein, the word-meaning is this: 
具戒者行于此中，
they keep (caranti) within that, 
为圆满戒而动作是作持；
they proceed as people who fulfil the virtues, thus it is keeping (caaritta); 
以此（止持戒）而遵守于禁止的是止持。
they preserve, they protect, they avoid, thus it is avoiding. 
又作持由信而起的精进所成就，
Herein, keeping is accomplished by faith and energy; 
止持由信所成就。
avoiding, by faith and mindfulness. 
这是作持、止持二种。
This is how it is of two kinds as keeping and avoiding.


（２）（等正行、初梵行）第二种二法：“等正行”，为最上的行为。
27. 3. In the second dyad good behaviour is the best kind of behaviour. 
等正行即等正行戒，
Good behaviour itself is that of good behaviour; 
或等正行是制定关于应行的等正行戒。
or what is announced for the sake of good behaviour is that of good behaviour. 
这除了活命第八的戒外，其他的都是同义语。
This is a term for virtue other than that which has livelihood as eighth. 
“初梵行”是说为道梵行的初步。
It is the initial stage of the life of purity consisting in the path, thus it is that of the beginning of the life of purity. 
活命第八即是此戒的同义语，
This is a term for the virtue that has livelihood as eighth. 
因为是修行者最初必须清净的部分，故说为道的初步。
It is the initial stage of the path because it has actually to be purified in the prior stage too. 
如说“首先他的身业、语业和活命已极清净”。
Hence it is said: “But his bodily action, his verbal action, and his livelihood have already been purified earlier” (M III 289). 
或者说微细的学处为等正行戒；
Or the training precepts called “lesser and minor” (D II 154) are that of good behaviour; 
其余的为初梵行戒。
the rest are that of the beginning of the life of purity. 
或以两种毗崩伽中所包摄的戒为初梵行，
Or what is included in the Double Code (the bhikkhus’ and bhikkhuniis’ Paatimokkha) is that of the beginning of the life of purity; 
犍度品所包摄的义务为等正行。
and that included in the duties set out in the Khandhakas [of Vinaya] is that of good behaviour. 
由于等正行的成就而初梵行戒才能成就。
Through its perfection that of the beginning of the life of purity comes to be perfected. 
故说
Hence it is said also 
“诸比丘！若彼比丘不得等正行法的圆满而能得初梵行法的圆满者，实无是处”。
“that this bhikkhu shall fulfil the state consisting in the beginning of the life of purity without having fulfilled the state consisting in good behaviour-that is not possible” (A III 14-15). 
这是等正行、初梵行二种。
So it is of two kinds as that of good behaviour and that of the beginning of the life of purity.


（３）（离、不离）于第三种二法中，离杀生等为“离戒”；
28.4.In the third dyad virtue as abstinence is simply abstention from killing living things, etc.; 
其余的思等为“不离戒”。
the other kinds consisting in volition, etc., are virtue as non-abstinence. 
这是离、不离二种。
So it is of two kinds as abstinence and non-abstinence.


（４）（依止、不依止）于第四种二法中，
29.5.In the fourth dyad there are two kinds of dependence: 
依有爱依、见依二种。
dependence through craving and dependence through [false] views. 
如说：“由于此戒，我将生天或生于某天”，为了成就这种目的而持戒的名为“爱依止”；
Herein, that produced by one who wishes for a fortunate kind of becoming thus, “Through this virtuous conduct [rite] I shall become a [great] deity or some [minor] deity” (M I 102), is dependent through craving. 
如果他想“依此戒而得净”，具此（以此为）净之见而持戒的为“见依止”。
That produced through such [false] view about purification as “Purification is through virtuous conduct” (Vibh 374) is dependent through [false] view. 
其次出世间戒及可作出世间的因缘的世间戒为“不依止”。
But the supramundane, and the mundane that is the prerequisite for the aforesaid supramundane, are independent. 
这是依止、不依止二种。
So it is of two kinds as dependent and independent.


（５）（时限、终身）于第五种二法中，限定一段时间受持的为“时限（戒）、
30. 6. In the fifth dyad temporary virtue is that undertaken after deciding on a time limit. 
尽其生命受持的为“终身（戒）”。
Lifelong virtue is that practiced in the same way but undertaking it for as long as life lasts. 
这是时限、终身二种。
So it is of two kinds as temporary and lifelong.


（６）（有限制、无限制）于第六种二法中，有利养、名誉、亲戚、肢体、生命的条件限制的，名为“有限制（戒）”；
31.7.In the sixth dyad the limited is that seen to be limited by gain, fame, relatives, limbs, or life. 
相反的为“无限制（戒）”。
The opposite is unlimited. 
在《无碍解道》也说：
And this is said in the Pa.tisambhidaa: 
“什么为有限制？
“What is the virtue that has a limit? 
即为利养限制戒，
There is virtue that has gain as its limit, 
为名誉限制戒，
there is virtue that has fame as its limit, 
为亲戚限制戒，
there is virtue that has relatives as its limit, 
为肢体限制戒，
there is virtue that has limbs as its limit, 
为生命限制戒。
there is virtue that has life as its limit. 
什么是为利养限制戒？
What is virtue that has gain as its limit? 
世间有人为利养因，
Here someone with gain as cause, 
为利养缘，
with gain as condition, 
为利养故，
with gain as reason, 
违犯其受持的学处，
transgresses a training precept as undertaken: 
这是为利养限制戒”。
that virtue has gain as its limit” (Pa.tis I 43), 
余者类推可知。
and the rest should be elaborated in the same way. 
对于无限制戒也有解答：
Also in the answer dealing with the unlimited it is said: 
“什么是不为利养限制戒？
“What is virtue that does not have gain as its limit? 
世间有人为利养因，
Here someone does not, with gain as cause, 
为利养缘，
with gain as condition, 
为利养故，
with gain as reason, 
甚至不生违犯其所受持的学处的心，
even arouse the thought of transgressing a training precept as undertaken, 
何况违犯？
how then shall he actually transgress it? 
这是不为利养限制戒”。
That virtue does not have gain as its limit” (Pa.tis I 44), 
余者类推可知。
and the rest should be elaborated in the same way. 
这是有限制、无限制二种。
So it is of two kinds as limited and unlimited.


（７）（世间、出世间）在第七种二法：
32.8.In the seventh dyad 
一切有漏戒为“世间戒”；
all virtue subject to cankers is mundane; 
无漏戒为“出世间戒”。
that not subject to cankers is supramundane. 
此中：世间戒能使有（生命）的殊胜，亦为出离三有的资粮。
Herein, the mundane brings about improvement in future becoming and is a prerequisite for the escape from becoming, 
所谓：
according as it is said: 
“毗奈耶意在律仪，
“Discipline is for the purpose of restraint, 
律仪意在无后悔，
restraint is for the purpose of non-remorse, 
无后悔意在愉悦，
non-remorse is for the purpose of gladdening, 
愉悦意在于喜，
gladdening is for the purpose of happiness, 
喜意在轻安，
happiness is for the purpose of tranquillity, 
轻安意在于乐，
tranquillity is for the purpose of bliss, 
乐意在于定，
bliss is for the purpose of concentration, 
定意在如实知见，
concentration is for the purpose of correct knowledge and vision, 
如实知见意在厌离，
correct knowledge and vision is for the purpose of dispassion, 
厌离意在离欲，
dispassion is for the purpose of fading away [of greed], 
离欲意在解脱，
fading away is for the purpose of deliverance, 
解脱意在解脱知见，
deliverance is for the purpose of knowledge and vision of deliverance, 
解脱知见意在无取涅槃。
knowledge and vision of deliverance is for the purpose of complete extinction [of craving, etc.] through not clinging. 
为此而说律，
Talk has that purpose, 
为此而讨论，
counsel has that purpose, 
为此而亲近学习，
support has that purpose, 
为此而谛听，
giving ear has that purpose, 
即是为此无执取心的解脱”。
that is to say, the liberation of the mind through not clinging” (Vin V 164). 
出世间戒能使出离于有漏，
The supramundane brings about the escape from becoming 
并为观察智的基地。
and is the plane of reviewing knowledge. 
这是世间、出世间二种。
So it is of two kinds as mundane and supramundane.


（三）（三法）于三法中：（１）（下、中、上）先说第一种三法：
33. 9. In the first of the triads 
如果由下等的欲、心、精进、观（四神足）所建立的戒为“下”；
the inferior is produced by inferior zeal, [purity of] consciousness, energy, or inquiry; 
由中等的欲等所建立的为“中”；
the medium is produced by medium zeal, etc.; 
由殊胜的欲等所建立的为“上”。
the superior, by superior (zeal, and so on). 
为求名誉而受持的为下；
That undertaken out of desire for fame is inferior; 
为求福果而受持的为中；
that undertaken out of desire for the fruits of merit is medium; 
但依“此是应作”的圣性而受持的为上。
that undertaken for the sake of the noble state thus, “This has to be done” is superior. 
或想“我是具戒者，其他的比丘都是恶戒者、恶法者”，有这种自举轻他的染污者为下；
Or again, that defiled by self-praise and disparagement of others, etc., thus, “I am possessed of virtue, but these other bhikkhus are ill-conducted and evil-natured” (M I 193), is inferior; 
无此染污者为中：
undefiled mundane virtue is medium; 
出世间戒为上。
supramundane is superior. 
或者以爱为出发点，为求生命享受而持戒者为下；
Or again, that motivated by craving, the purpose of which is to enjoy continued existence, is inferior; 
为求自己解脱而持戒者为中；
that practiced for the purpose of one’s own deliverance is medium; 
为求一切众生解脱而受持的波罗蜜戒为上。
the virtue of the perfections practiced for the deliverance of all beings is superior. 
这是下中上三种。
So it is of three kinds as inferior, medium, and superior.


（２）（我增上、世间增上、法增上）于第二种三法中：
34.10. In the second triad 
为求弃舍自己不适当的，为自尊自重而受持的为“我增上”（戒）。
that practiced out of self-regard by one who regards self and desires to abandon what is unbecoming to self is virtue giving precedence to self. 
欲求避免世间的批评，欲为世间尊重及尊重世间而受持的为“世间增上”（戒）。
That practiced out of regard for the world and out of desire to ward off the censure of the world is virtue giving precedence to the world. 
为求恭敬大法、为尊重法而受持的为“法增上（戒）”。
That practiced out of regard for the Dhamma and out of desire to honour the majesty of the Dhamma is virtue giving precedence to the Dhamma. 
这是我增上等三种。
So it is of three kinds as giving precedence to self, and so on.


（３）（执取、不执取、安息）于第三种三法中：
35.11. In the third triad 
如前二种法中所说的依止，因他以爱见而执取，故名“执取（戒）”，
the virtue that in the dyads was called dependent (no.5) is adhered-to because it is adhered-to through craving and [false] view. 
若为良善凡夫之道的资粮，
That practiced by the magnanimous ordinary man as the prerequisite of the path, 
并与诸有学道相应的为“不执取（戒）”。
and that associated with the path in trainers, are not-adhered-to. 
若与诸有学果及无学果相应的为“安息（戒）”。
That associated with trainers’ and non-trainers’ fruition is tranquillized. 
这是执取等三种。
So it is of three kinds as adhered-to, and so on.


（４）（清净、不清净、有疑）于第四种三法中：
36.12. In the fourth triad 
诸戒完具不犯罪者，
that fulfilled by one who has committed no offence 
或犯了罪而更忏悔者为“清净（戒）”。
or has made amends after committing one is pure. 
犯了罪不忏悔的为“不清净（戒）”。
So long as he has not made amends after committing an offence it is impure. 
对于犯罪的事物（对象），犯的那种罪，是否有犯罪的行为而生疑惑者的戒为“有疑戒”。
Virtue in one who is dubious about whether a thing constitutes an offence or about what grade of offence has been committed or about whether he has committed an offence is dubious. 
是故诸瑜伽者（修行者）应该净化其不清净的戒，
Herein, the meditator should purify impure virtue. 
不对有疑惑的事物而采取行动，
If dubious, he should avoid cases about which he is doubtful 
并应除其疑惑。
and should get his doubts cleared up. 
这样他将得到安乐。
In this way his mind will be kept at rest. 
这是清净等三种。
So it is of three kinds as pure, and so on.


（５）（学、无学、非学非无学）于第五种三法中：
37.13. In the fifth triad 
与四圣道及三沙门果相应的戒为“学（戒）”。
the virtue associated with the four paths and with the [first] three fruitions is that of the trainer. 
与阿罗汉果相应的戒为“无学（戒）”。
That associated with the fruition of Arahantship is that of the non-trainer. 
其余的为“非学非无学（戒）”。
The remaining kinds are that of the neither-trainer-nor-non-trainer. 
这是学等三种。
So it is of three kinds as that of the trainer, and so on.

但在《无碍解道》里把世间众生的天性也说为戒。
38.But in the world the nature of such and such beings is called their “habit” (siila) of which they say: 
例如说：这是乐戒（乐观性），
“This one is of happy habit (sukha-siila), 
这是苦戒（悲观性），
this one is of unhappy habit, 
这是争论戒（好争论的），
this one is of quarrelsome habit, 
这是庄严戒（好装饰的）等。
this one is of dandified habit.” 
因此在那里说
Because of that it is said in the Pa.tisambhidaa figuratively: 
“有三种戒，即善戒、不善戒、无记戒”，
“Three kinds of virtue (habit): profitable virtue, unprofitable virtue, indeterminate virtue” (Pa.tis I 44). 
把善等也作为三种戒说。
So it is also called of three kinds as profitable, and so on. 
当知象那里所举的“不善”，与本论所讲的戒相等的意义是没有一种可以相合的，所以本论不取。
Of these, the unprofitable is not included here since it has nothing whatever to do with the headings beginning with the characteristic, which define virtue in the sense intended in this [chapter]. 
是故当依上述的方法而知三种戒。
So the threefoldness should be understood only in the way already stated.


（四）（四法）于四法中：（１）（退分、住分、胜分、抉择分）第一种四法：
39.14. In the first of the tetrads:
亲近恶戒者不与持戒的为友，
The unvirtuous he cultivates, He visits not the virtuous,
无知者不见犯事的过咎，
And in his ignorance he sees No fault in a transgression here, 
充满邪思惟，诸根不防护，
With wrong thoughts often in his mind His faculties he will not guard-
此人必然生起“退分戒”。
Virtue in such a constitutionComes to partake of diminution.
悦于此世有戒的成就，
But he whose mind is satisfied. With virtue that has been achieved,
对于业处（定境）无意而精勤，
Who never thinks to stir himself And take a meditation subject up,
以戒自满，更不向上而努力，
Contented with mere virtuousness, Nor striving for a higher state-
这是比丘的“住分戒”成就。
His virtue bears the appellation Of that partaking of stagnation.
圆满了戒，更加为定而努力，
But who, possessed of virtue, strives With concentration for his aim-
这是比丘的“胜分戒”成就。
That bhikkhu’s virtue in its function Is called partaking of distinction.
不以戒满足，更为厌离而努力，
Who finds mere virtue not enough But has dispassion for his goal-
这是比丘“抉择分戒”的成就。
His virtue through such aspiration Comes to partake of penetration.
这是退分等四种。
So it is of four kinds as partaking of diminution, and so on.


（２）（比丘、比丘尼、未具足、在家）于第二种四法中：
40.15. In the second tetrad 
制定关于比丘的学处，或者为比丘尼所制定的学处亦应为比丘所守护的戒为“比丘戒”。
there are training precepts announced for bhikkhus to keep irrespective of what is announced for bhikkhuniis. This is the virtue of bhikkhus. 
制定关于比丘尼的学处，或者为诸比丘所制定的学处亦应为比丘尼所守护的戒为“比丘尼戒”。
There are training precepts announced for bhikkhuniis to keep irrespective of what is announced for bhikkhus. This is the virtue of bhikkhuniis. 
沙弥、沙弥尼的十戒为“未具足戒”。
The ten precepts of virtue for male and female novices are the virtue of the not fully admitted. 
优婆塞、优婆夷的常戒五学处，若可能时增为十学处，依布萨支为八学处，此为“在家戒”。
The five training precepts-ten when possible-as a permanent undertaking and eight as the factors of the Uposatha Day, for male and female lay followers are the virtue of the laity. 
这是比丘戒等四种。
So it is of four kinds as the virtue of bhikkhus, and so on.

（３）（自然、惯行、法性、宿因）
41.16. In the third tetrad 
如北俱卢洲的人们自然而然不会违犯的为“自然戒”。种族、地方、宗教等各自规定其奉持的条例为“惯行戒”。
the non-transgression on the part of Uttarakuru human beings is natural virtue. Each clan’s or locality’s or sect’s own rules of conduct are customary virtue. 
“阿难，自从菩萨入母胎之后，那菩萨的母亲，对于男子便不起爱欲之念，是为法性”，这样说菩萨母亲的戒为“法性戒”。
The virtue of the Bodhisatta’s mother described thus: “It is the necessary rule, Ānanda, that when the Bodhisatta has descended into his mother’s womb, no thought of men that is connected with the cords of sense desire comes to her” (D II 13), is necessary virtue. 
其次如大迦叶等清净有情及菩萨在世世生生的戒为“宿因戒”。
But the virtue of such pure beings as Mahaa Kassapa, etc., and of the Bodhisatta in his various births is virtue due to previous causes. 
这是自然等四种。
So it is of four kinds as natural virtue, and so on.


（４）（第四种四法的说明）（别解脱律仪、根律仪、活命遍净、资具依止）于第四种四法中，
42.17. In the fourth tetrad:
世尊说：
(a) The virtue described by the Blessed One thus: 
“此比丘，以别解脱律仪防护而住，
“Here a bhikkhu dwells restrained with the Paatimokkha restraint, 
正行与行处具足，
possessed of the [proper] conduct and resort, 
对于微细的罪过亦见其怖畏，
and seeing fear in the slightest fault, 
受持学习诸学处”
he trains himself by undertaking the precepts of training, (Vibh 244)” 
这样说的戒为“别解脱律仪戒”。
is virtue of Paatimokkha restraint.
其次：“彼人眼见色已，
(b) That described thus: “On seeing a visible object with the eye, 
不取于相，
he apprehends neither the signs 
不取细相。
nor the particulars through which, 
因为他的眼根若不防护而住，
if he left the eye faculty unguarded, 
则为贪、忧、诸恶、不善法所侵入，
evil and unprofitable states of covetousness and grief might invade him; 
故彼防护而行道，
he enters upon the way of its restraint, 
保护眼根，
he guards the eye faculty, 
作眼根律仪。
undertakes the restraint of the eye faculty. 
如是耳闻声已……
On hearing a sound with the ear … 
鼻嗅香已、
On smelling an odour with the nose … 
舌尝味已、
On tasting a flavour with the tongue … 
身触所触已，
On touching a tangible object with the body … 
意知法已，
On cognizing a mental object with the mind, 
不取于相………乃至意根律仪”，
he apprehends neither the signs nor the particulars through which, if he left the mind faculty unguarded, evil and unprofitable states of covetousness and grief might invade him; he enters upon the way of its restraint, he guards the mind faculty, undertakes the restraint of the mind faculty (M I 180), 
这样说的为“根律仪戒”。
is virtue of restraint of the sense faculties.
其次，舍离由于违犯为活命之因而制定的六种学处（所起的邪命）
(c) Abstinence from such wrong livelihood as entails transgression of the six training precepts announced with respect to livelihood 
以及（离弃）由诡诈、虚谈、现相、嗔骂示相、以利求利等恶法所起的邪命，
and entails the evil states beginning with “Scheming, talking, hinting, belittling, pursuing gain with gain” (M II 75) 
为“活命遍净戒”。
is virtue of livelihood purification.
“如理抉择，为防寒冷应用衣服”的表现，是说清净决择而后应用四种资具，
(d) Use of the four requisites that is purified by the reflection stated in the way beginning, “Reflecting wisely, he uses the robe only for protection from cold” (M I 10) 
故名“资具依止戒”。
is called virtue concerning requisites.


现在对这第四种四法的句子次第解释如下：
43.Here is an explanatory exposition together with a word commentary starting from the beginning.


（１）别解脱律仪戒

“此”，即于此佛教中。
(a) Here: in this dispensation. 

“比丘”，
A bhikkhu: 
因为能见轮回的怖畏，或为穿着截割破布等的意思，所以他得这样的通称，即以别解脱律仪防护由信出家的善男子。
a clansman who has gone forth out of faith and is so styled because he sees fear in the round of rebirths (sa.msaare bhaya.m ikkhanataa) or because he wears cloth garments that are torn and pieced together, and so on.

“以别解脱律仪防护”，
Restrained with the Paatimokkha restraint: 
这里的别解脱律仪即是学处戒。
here “Paatimokkha” (Rule of the Community) is the virtue of the training precepts; 
因为守护者得以解脱
for it frees (mokkheti) him who protects (paati) it, guards it, 
及离恶趣等苦，
it sets him free (mocayati) from the pains of the states of loss, etc., 
故名“别解脱”。
that is why it is called Paatimokkha. 
律仪即防护，
“Restraint” is restraining; 
是依身语的不犯为名。
this is a term for bodily and verbal non-transgression. 
别解脱自己便是律仪，所以名为“别解脱律仪”。
The Paatimokkha itself as restraint is “Paatimokkha restraint.”
以别解脱律仪而防护，为“以别解脱律仪防护”。
“Restrained with the Paatimokkha restraint” is restrained by means of the restraint consisting in that Paatimokkha; 

“防护”是保持及具备的意思。
he has it, possesses it, is the meaning. 

“住”为行止之意。
Dwells: bears himself in one of the postures. 





“正行与行处具足”等意义，
44. The meaning of possessed of  [the proper] conduct and resort, etc., 
当知在圣典中已有叙述。
should be understood in the way in which it is given in the text. 
即所谓：
For this is said: 
“正行与行处具足，
“Possessed of [the proper] conduct and resort: 
先说正行，有不正行与正行。
there is [proper] conduct and improper conduct. 
什么是不正行？
Herein, what is improper conduct? 
由于身的违犯、
Bodily transgression, 
语的违犯，
verbal transgression, 
身语的违犯，
bodily and verbal transgressionr--
是名不正行。
this is called improper conduct. 
亦可说一切的恶戒为不正行。
Also all unvirtuousness is improper conduct. 
兹或有人，（为了生活的某种目的）以竹布施、
Here someone makes a livelihood by gifts of bamboos, 
以叶布施，
or by gifts of leaves, 
或以花、果、盥洗的粉及齿木等布施，
or by gifts of flowers, fruits, bathing powder, and tooth sticks, 
或说谄谀语，
or by flattery, 
或说豆汤语，
or by bean-soupery, 
或以抚爱（抚爱他人的孩子），
or by fondling, 
或为走使传讯，
or by going on errands on foot, 
或以种种为佛陀所唾弃的不正当的生活手段以营求其生活，
or by one or other of the sorts of wrong livelihood condemned by the Buddhas--
都称为不正行。
this is called improper conduct. 


什么是正行？
Herein, what is [proper] conduct? 
身不违犯，
Bodily non-transgression, 
语不违犯，
verbal non-transgression, 
身语不违犯，
bodily and verbal non-transgression-
是名正行。
this is called [proper] conduct. 
亦可说一切的戒律仪为正行，
Also all restraint through virtue is [proper] conduct. 
兹或有人，
Here someone 
不以竹布施，
“does not make a livelihood by gifts of bamboos, 
不以叶、花、果、盥洗之粉及齿木等布施，
or by gifts of leaves, or by gifts of flowers, fruits, bathing powder, and tooth sticks, 
或不说谄谀语，
or by flattery, 
不说豆汤语，
or by bean-soupery, or by fondling, 
不为走使传讯，
or by going on errands on foot, 
不以种种为佛陀所唾弃的不正当的生活手段以营求其生活，
or by one or other of the sorts of wrong livelihood condemned by the Buddhas-
都称为正行。
this is called [proper] conduct.”


次说行处，亦有行处与非行处。
45.“[Proper] resort: there is [proper] resort and improper resort. 
什么是非行处？
Herein, what is improper resort? 
兹或有人，
Here someone 
行于淫女处，或行于寡妇、黄门（阴阳男女及宦官）、比丘尼及酒肆之处，或与国王、大臣、外道及外道的弟子等俗人作不适当的交际而住，
has prostitutes as resort, or he has widows, old maids, eunuchs, bhikkhuniis, or taverns as resort; or he dwells associated with kings, kings’ ministers, sectarians, sectarians’ disciples, in unbecoming association with laymen; 
或与那些对于比丘、比丘尼、优婆塞、优婆夷无信仰、无欢喜、不供泉水（如无水之井不能供给所需）、骂詈谗谤、不欲他们得利益、不欲其适意、不欲其有瑜伽安稳的俗人相依亲近往来者，
or he cultivates, frequents, honours, such families as are faithless, untrusting, abusive and rude, who wish harm, wish ill, wish woe, wish no surcease of bondage, for bhikkhus and bhikkhuniis, for male and female devotees-
名非行处。
this is called improper resort. 


什么是行处，
Herein, what is [proper] resort? 
兹或有人，
Here someone 
不行于淫女处……不行于酒肆之处，不与国王……外道的弟子等俗人作不适当的交际而住，
does not have prostitutes as resort … or taverns as resort; he does not dwell associated with kings … sectarians’ disciples, in unbecoming association with laymen; 
或与那些对于比丘……优婆夷有信仰、欢喜、能供泉水（可以满足需求的）、爱袈裟的光辉、喜比丘等出入、欲比丘等得利益……欲其有瑜伽安稳的俗人相依亲近往来者，
he cultivates, frequents, honours, such families as are faithful and trusting, who are a solace, where the yellow cloth glows, where the breeze of sages blows, who wish good, wish well, wish joy, wish surcease of bondage, for bhikkhus and bhikkhuniis, for male and female devotees-
名为行处。
this is called [proper] resort. 
能够具足、正具足、达、正达、成就、正成就、圆满这样的正行和行处，
Thus he is furnished with, fully furnished with, provided with, fully provided with, supplied with, possessed of, endowed with, this [proper] conduct and this [proper] resort. 
所以称为“正行与行处具足”。
Hence it is said, ’Possessed of [the proper] conduct and resort’” (Vibh 246-47).


其次当知正行与行处具足也可这样说：
46.Furthermore, [proper] conduct and resort should also be understood here in the following way; 
即不正行有身语二种。
for improper conduct is twofold as bodily and verbal. 

什么是身不正行？
Herein, what is bodily improper conduct? 
兹或有人，在僧众中，不思尊敬长老比丘，
“Here someone acts disrespectfully before the Community, 
挥开他们冲进去立，
and he stands jostling elder bhikkhus, 
冲进去坐，
sits jostling them, 
在前面立，
stands in front of them, 
在前面坐，
sits in front of them, 
在高座坐，
sits on a high seat, 
用衣缠头而坐，
sits with his head covered, 
站立说话，
talks standing up, 
挥手说话，
talks waving his arms … 
诸长老比丘没有穿履经行，他却穿履经行，
walks with sandals while elder bhikkhus walk without sandals, 
长老在低经行处经行，他在高经行处经行，
walks on a high walk while they walk on a low walk, 
长老在普通的地上经行，他在经行处经行，
walks on a walk while they walk on the ground … 
或者侵害长老的位置而立，
stands pushing elder bhikkhus, 
侵占其座位而坐，
sits pushing them, 
又拒绝新学比丘于座位之外，
prevents new bhikkhus from getting a seat … 
在向火的房中不咨询长老比丘而自添薪火，
and in the bath house … without asking elder bhikkhus he puts wood on [the stove] … 
关闭门户，
bolts the door … 
在水浴场上亦冲开长老比丘行下去，
and at the bathing place he enters the water jostling elder bhikkhus, 
先下去，
enters it in front of them, 
冲进去沐浴，
bathes jostling them, 
先沐浴，
bathes in front of them, 
冲上来，
comes out jostling them, 
先上来，
comes out in front of them … 
进入村落人家，冲进长老比丘而行，
and entering inside a house he goes jostling elder bhikkhus, 
在前行，
goes in front of them, 
超越长老比丘的前面去行，
pushing forward he goes in front of them … 
有家庭主妇和少女们坐在那里的秘密隐藏的内室，他突然闯入，
and where families have inner private screened rooms in which the women of the family … the girls of the family, sit, there he enters abruptly, 
触摸小孩子的头，
and he strokes a child’s head” (Nidd I 228–29). 
是名身不正行。
This is called bodily improper conduct.


什么是语不正行？
47.Herein, what is verbal improper conduct? 
兹或有人，在僧众中，不思尊敬长老比丘，
“Here someone acts disrespectfully before the Community. 
不咨询而自说法，
Without asking elder bhikkhus he talks on the Dhamma, 
解答问题，
answers questions, 
诵波罗提木叉戒，
recites the Paatimokkha, 
站立说话，
talks standing up, 
挥手说话，
talks waving his arms … 
进入村落人家对妇人或少女们这样说，
having entered inside a house, he speaks to a woman or a girl thus: 
某名某姓门下有些什么？
‘You, so-and-so of such-and-such a clan, what is there? 
有粥吗？
Is there rice gruel? 
有饭吗？
Is there cooked rice? 
有硬食吗？
Is there any hard food to eat? 
我们有什么喝的呢？
What shall we drink? 
有什么吃的呢？
What hard food shall we eat? 
有什么吞啖的呢？
What soft food shall we eat? 
有什么东西送给我们吗？
Or what will you give me?’--
象这样的拉杂空谈，
he chatters like this” (Nidd I 230). 
名为语不正行。
This is called verbal improper conduct.


其次当知和上面相反的为正行。
48. Proper conduct should be understood in the opposite sense to that. 

如有比丘，尊敬顺从长上，
Furthermore, a bhikkhu is respectful, deferential, 
具有惭愧、
possessed of conscience and shame, 
整齐庄严的穿着（内衣和外衣）、
wears his inner robe properly, wears his upper robe properly, 
正当的前进、后退、
his manner inspires confidence whether in moving forwards or backwards, 
前视、旁视
looking ahead or aside, 
及屈伸其肢体、
bending or stretching, 
眼睛下视、
his eyes are downcast, 
威仪具足，
he has (a good) deportment, 
掩护六根门头，
he guards the doors of his sense faculties, 
饮食知量，
knows the right measure in eating, 
常事醒觉，
is devoted to wakefulness, 
具备正念正知，
possesses mindfulness and full awareness, 
少欲
wants little, 
知足，
is contented, 
常勤精进，
is strenuous, 
对于诸等正行
is a careful observer of good behaviour, 
完全诚意恭敬尊重而住，
and treats the teachers with great respect. 
是名正行。
This is called (proper) conduct.

如是当知先为正行。
This firstly is how (proper) conduct should be understood.


其次行处：
49.(Proper) resort is of three kinds: 
有近依行处，
(proper) resort as support, 
守护行处，
(proper) resort as guarding, 
近缚行处三种。
and (proper) resort as anchoring. 

什么是近依行处？
Herein, what is (proper) resort as support? 
具足十论事之德的善友为近依行处。
A good friend who exhibits the instances of talk, 
因为依他可以闻所未闻、
in whose presence one hears what has not been heard, 
已闻的更明白，
corrects what has been heard, 
解决疑惑，
gets rid of doubt, 
矫正意见，
rectifies one’s view, 
安息其心，
and gains confidence; 
或者跟他学习可以增信，
or by training under whom one grows in faith, 
亦得增长戒、
virtue, 
闻、
learning, 
舍、
generosity 
慧，
and understanding--
故称近依行处。
this is called (proper) resort as support.


什么是守护行处？
50.What is (proper) resort as guarding? 
兹有比丘，进入村落行于道上，
Here “A bhikkhu, having entered inside a house, having gone into a street, 
收缩眼界仅见眼前一寻之地，
goes with downcast eyes, seeing the length of a plough yoke, 
善加防护而行，
restrained, 
不见象（兵），
not looking at an elephant, 
不见马（兵）、
not looking at a horse, 
车（兵）、
a carriage, 
步（兵）、
a pedestrian, 
妇女、
a woman, 
男人，
a man, 
不看上，
not looking up, 
不看下，
not looking down, 
不视四方和四维而行，
not staring this way and that” (Nidd I 474). 
是名守护行处。
This is called (proper) resort as guarding.


什么是近缚行处？
51.What is (proper) resort as anchoring? 
便是约束其心于四念住中。
It is the four foundations of mindfulness on which the mind is anchored; 
世尊说：
for this is said by the Blessed One: 
“诸比丘！什么是比丘行处，
“Bhikkhus, what is a bhikkhu’s resort, 
什么是你们的世袭传承？
his own native place? 
便是四念住”。
It is these four foundations of mindfulness” (S V 148). 
是名近缚行处。
This is called (proper) resort as anchoring.

这样的正行和行处具足圆满，
Being thus furnished with … endowed with, this (proper) conduct and this (proper) resort, 
故说“正行与行处具足”。
he is also on that account called “one possessed of (proper) conduct and resort.” 


“对于微细的罪过亦见其怖畏”，便是对于无意而犯的众学法及生起不善心等的微细罪过，亦能见其怖畏。
52.Seeing fear in the slightest fault (§42): one who has the habit (siila) of seeing fear in faults of the minutest measure, of such kinds as unintentional contravening of a minor training rule of the Paatimokkha, or the arising of unprofitable thoughts. 

“受持与学习诸学处”，便是对于任何应当学习的学处都正持学习。
He trains himself by undertaking (samaadaaya) the precepts of training:  whatever there is among the precepts of training to be trained in, in all that he trains by taking it up rightly (sammaa aadaaya).  

这里，“以别解脱律仪防护”，是依于人而决定为说别解脱律仪的。
And here, as far as the words, “one restrained by the Paatimokkha restraint,” virtue of Paatimokkha restraint is shown by discourse in terms of persons.
其次“正行与行处具足”等的一切，都是关于如何圆成行道者的戒，当知是为示行道而说的。
But all that beginning with the words, “possessed of [proper] conduct and resort” should be understood as said in order to show the way of practice that perfects that virtue in him who so practices it.


（Ⅱ）根律仪戒

继前文之后又说：“彼人眼见色已……”等等，是显示根律仪戒。
53.(b) Now, as regards the virtue of restraint of faculties shown next to that in the way beginning, “on seeing a visible object with the eye,” 
“彼人”，是指坚持别解脱律仪戒的比丘。
herein he is a bhikkhu established in the virtue of Pātimokkha restraint. 

“眼见色已”，
On seeing a visible object with the eye: 
是由于有见色能力的眼识而见色已的意思。
on seeing a visible object with the eye-consciousness that is capable of seeing visible objects and has borrowed the name “eye” from its instrument. 
然而古人说：
But the Ancients (poraa.naa) said: 
“无心故眼不能见色，
“The eye does not see a visible object because it has no mind. 
无眼故心亦不能见色：
The mind does not see because it has no eyes. 
当（眼）门与所缘（之境）相接的时候，由于以眼净色为依止（而起）的心才能见色”。
But when there is the impingement of door and object he sees by means of the consciousness that has eye-sensitivity as its physical basis. 
这种说法好象真的为见的原因论，
Now, (an idiom) such as this is called an ‘accessory locution’ (sasambhaarakathaa), 
正如有人（说射箭）说“我以弓射”一样。
like ‘He shot him with his bow,’ and so on. 
是故以眼识见色已便是这里的正确意义。
So the meaning here is this: ‘On seeing a visible object with eye-consciousness.’”


“不取于相”，
54.Apprehends neither the signs: 
便是对于男女相，净相（可悦相）等而能生起烦恼的一切事相不取着，
he does not apprehend the sign of woman or man, or any sign that is a basis for defilement such as the sign of beauty, etc.; 
而止于他真实所见的。
he stops at what is merely seen. 


“不取细相”，
Nor the particulars: 
便是对于能使烦恼显现而得通名为细相的手、足、微笑、大笑、语、视等种种相不生取着，
he does not apprehend any aspect classed as hand, foot, smile, laughter, talk, looking ahead, looking aside, etc., which has acquired the name “particular” (anubya~njana) because of its particularizing (anu anu bya~njanato) defilements, because of its making them manifest themselves. 
他仅见其所见的真实部分，
He only apprehends what is really there. 


犹如住在支提山的大帝须长老一样。
Like the Elder Mahaa Tissa who dwelt at Cetiyapabbata.


据说：长老从支提山来阿努罗陀补罗乞食，
55.It seems that as the elder was on his way from Cetiyapabbata to Anuraadhapura for alms, 
有一位良家妇女和她的丈夫争吵了以后，装饰得象天女一样美丽，早晨从阿努罗陀补罗城内出来向她的娘家走去，
a certain daughter-in-law of a clan, who had quarrelled with her husband and had set out early from Anuraadhapura all dressed up and tricked out like a celestial nymph to go to her relatives’ home, 
在中途碰见了长老，
saw him on the road, 
生颠倒心，向他大笑。
and being low-minded, she laughed a loud laugh. 
当时长老想：“这是什么”？于是向她一看（看见了她的笑口的牙齿），
[Wondering] “What is that?” the elder looked up 
便对她的牙骨部分作不净想，
and finding in the bones of her teeth the perception of foulness (ugliness), 
证得阿罗汉果。
he reached Arahantship. 
于是他说：
Hence it was said:
看见了她的齿骨，
“He saw the bones that were her teeth,
随念于以前所修的不净之想，
And kept in mind his first perception;
长老就站在那里，
And standing on that very spot
证得了阿罗汉果。
The elder became an Arahant.”
这时，她的丈夫亦从同一路上追寻而来，
But her husband, who was going after her, 
看见了长老问道：
saw the elder and asked, 
“尊者，你看见什么妇女吗”？
“Venerable sir, did you by any chance see a woman?” 
长老说：
The elder told him:
我不知道是男是女，向这路上走去，
“Whether it was a man or woman That went by I noticed not,
但见一堆骨聚，行于这平平的大路。
But only that on this high road There goes a group of bones.”


“因为他的眼根若不防护”，是说因为不以念之窗防护眼根及关闭眼门的人，便为贪等法所侵入所系缚。
56.As to the words through which, etc., the meaning is: by reason of which, because of which non-restraint of the eye faculty, if he, if that person, left the eye faculty unguarded, remained with the eye door unclosed by the door-panel of mindfulness, these states of covetousness, etc., might invade, might pursue, might threaten, him. 

“彼防护而行道”，
He enters upon the way of its restraint: 
是说以念窗关闭他的眼根而行道。
he enters upon the way of closing that eye faculty by the door-panel of mindfulness. 
若能如是行道者，即名“保护眼根，
It is the same one of whom it is said he guards the eye faculty, 
作眼根律仪”。
undertakes the restraint of the eye faculty.

仅在眼根中，实无任何律仪或不律仪可说，
57.Herein, there is neither restraint nor non-restraint in the actual eye faculty, 
在眼净色所依亦无有念或忘念生起。
since neither mindfulness nor forgetfulness arises in dependence on eye-sensitivity. 
当所缘之色现于眼前之时，
On the contrary when a visible datum as object comes into the eye’s focus, 
经过有分（识）二次生灭之后，
then, after the life-continuum has arisen twice and ceased, 
便起了唯作意界的转向作用，
the functional mind-element accomplishing the function of adverting arises and ceases. 
经过一生灭之后，便有眼识的见的作用，
After that, eye-consciousness with the function of seeing; 
自此有异熟意界的领受作用，
after that, resultant mind-element with the function of receiving; 
其次有异熟无因意识界的推度作用，
after that, resultant root-causeless mind-consciousness-element with the function of investigating; 
其次有唯作无因意识界的确定作用，
after that, functional root-causeless mind-consciousness-element accomplishing the function of determining arises and ceases. 
经过一生灭之后，便起速行的作用了。
Next to that, impulsion impels. 
这里在有分，转向（乃至确定）等的任何作用阶段都没有律仪或不律仪可说。
Herein, there is neither restraint nor non-restraint on the occasion of the life-continuum, or on any of the occasions beginning with adverting. 
但在速行的刹那，如果生起恶戒，或忘念、无智、无忍、懈怠，便为不律仪，
But there is non-restraint if unvirtuousness or forgetfulness or unknowing or impatience or idleness arises at the moment of impulsion. 
如是发生而说他为眼根不律仪。
When this happens, it is called “non-restraint in the eye faculty.” 

何以故？
58.Why is that? 
因为那时眼门没有守护了，
Because when this happens, the door is not guarded, 
则有分与转向等的路线亦无守护。
nor are the life-continuum and the consciousnesses of the cognitive series. 
譬如城市的四门若无守护，
Like what? Just as, when a city’s four gates are not secured, 
虽然城内的
although inside the city 
家门、
house doors, 
仓库、
storehouses, 
内室等
rooms, etc., 
善加守护，
are secured, 
但城中的一切财货实无保障，
yet all property inside the city is unguarded and unprotected 
因诸盗贼可从城门而入市内恣其所欲而作故。
since robbers coming in by the city gates can do as they please, 
同样的，
so too, 
如果在速行的阶段起了恶戒等，则那时成为不律仪，
when unvirtuousness, etc., arise in impulsion in which there is no restraint, 
眼门便无守护，
then the door too is unguarded, 
于是有分及转向等的路线亦无守护了。
and so also are the life-continuum and the consciousnesses of the cognitive series beginning with adverting. 
若在速行时生起戒等，
But when virtue, etc., has arisen in it, 
则眼门有了守护，
then the door too is guarded 
于是有分及转向等的路线也有了守护。
and so also are the life-continuum and the consciousnesses of the cognitive series beginning with adverting. 
譬如城门若能善加守护，
Like what? Just as, when the city gates are secured, 
虽然城里的家门没有守护，
although inside the city the houses, etc., are not secured, 
但市内的一切财货亦善能保障，
yet all property inside the city is well guarded, well protected, 
因为城门紧闭没有盗贼可以进去了。
since when the city gates are shut there is no ingress for robbers, 
同样的，若在速行的阶段生起戒等，
so too, when virtue, etc., have arisen in impulsion, 
则眼门有所守护，
the door too is guarded 
于是有分及转向等的路线也有守护了。
and so also are the life-continuum and the consciousnesses of the cognitive series beginning with adverting. 
故在速行的刹那而生起律仪，名为眼根律仪。
Thus although it actually arises at the moment of impulsion, it is nevertheless called “restraint in the eye faculty.”


“耳闻声已”等其义亦尔。
59.So also as regards the phrases on hearing a sound with the ear and so on. 

如是当知业已略说以回避取着色等烦恼随缚相为特相的根律仪戒。
So it is this virtue, which in brief has the characteristic of avoiding apprehension of signs entailing defilement with respect to visible objects, etc., that should be understood as virtue of restraint of faculties.


（Ⅲ）活命遍净戒

今于根律仪戒之后而说活命遍净戒。
60.(c) Now, as regards the virtue of livelihood purification mentioned above next to the virtue of restraint of the faculties (§42), 

“为活命之因而制定的六种学处”如下：
the words of the six precepts announced on account of livelihood mean, of the following six training precepts announced thus: 

“（一）恶欲者，为欲所败者，为活命因及活命原由，
“With livelihood as cause, with livelihood as reason, one of evil wishes, a prey to wishes, 
实无所得而说得上人法，
lays claim to a higher than human state that is non-existent, not a fact,” 
犯（第四）波罗夷罪。
the contravention of which is defeat (expulsion from the Order); 

（二）为活命因及活命原由
“with livelihood as cause, with livelihood as reason, 
而作媒介者，
he acts as go-between,” 
犯（第五）僧残罪。
the contravention of which is an offence entailing a meeting of the Order; 

（三）为活命因而如是公开的说：
“with livelihood as cause, with livelihood as reason, he says, 
‘住在某精舍中的那位比丘是阿罗汉’，
‘A bhikkhu who lives in your monastery is an Arahant,’” 
犯偷兰遮罪（舍堕）。
the contravention of which is a serious offence in one who is aware of it; 

（四）为活命因及活命原由，
“with livelihood as cause, with livelihood as reason, 
无病比丘，
a bhikkhu who is not sick 
为了自己而用意令作美味而食者，
eats superior food that he has ordered for his own use,” 
犯（第三十九）单堕罪。
the contravention of which is an offence requiring expiation; 

（五）为活命因及活命原由，
“With livelihood as cause, with livelihood as reason, 
无病比丘尼，
a bhikkhunii who is not sick 
为了自己而用意令作美味而食者，
eats superior food that she has ordered for her own use,” 
犯（第三）悔过罪。
the contravention of which is an offence requiring confession; 

（六）为活命因及活命原由，
“with livelihood as cause, with livelihood as reason, 
无病，
one who is not sick 
但为了自己而用意令作汤或饭而食者，
eats curry or boiled rice that he has ordered for his own use,”
犯恶作罪”。
the contravention of which is an offence of wrongdoing (Vin V 146). 

这便是制定的六学处。
Of these six precepts.


“诡诈”等，
61.As regards scheming, etc. (§42), 
在圣典中这样解释：
this is the text: 
“什么是诡诈？即为利养、恭敬、名誉所执着的恶欲者、为欲所败者，所谓以拒绝资具，或以迂回之说，或以威仪的装束，做作，矫饰，颦眉，蹙额，诡诈，虚伪，欺诈，
“Herein, what is scheming? It is the grimacing, grimacery, scheming, schemery, schemedness, by what is called rejection of requisites or by indirect talk, or it is the disposing, posing, composing, of the deportment on the part of one bent on gain, honour and renown, of one of evil wishes, a prey to wishes--
是名诡诈。
this is called scheming.


什么是虚谈？
62.”Herein, what is talking? 
即为利养、恭敬、名誉所执着的恶欲者、为欲所败者，对于他人无问虚谈、虚谈、极虚谈、赞虚谈、极赞虚谈、缠络语、极缠络语、举说、极举说、随爱语、谄谀语、豆汤语、养育状，
Talking at others, talking, talking round, talking up, continual talking up, persuading, continual persuading, suggesting, continual suggesting, ingratiating chatter, flattery, bean-soupery, fondling, on the part of one bent on gain, honour and renown, of one of evil wishes, a prey to wishes--
是名虚谈。
this is called talking. 


什么是现相？
63.”Herein, what is hinting? 
即为利养、恭敬、名誉所执着的恶欲者、为欲所败者，对于他人示相、示相业、暗示、暗示业、迂回谈、曲折说，
A sign to others, giving a sign, indication, giving indication, indirect talk, roundabout talk, on the part of one bent on gain, honour and renown, of one of evil wishes, a prey to wishes--
是名现相。
this is called hinting.


什么是嗔骂示相？
64. ”Herein, what is belittling? 
即为利养、恭敬、名誉所执着的恶欲者、为欲所败者，对于他人怒骂、侮蔑、呵责、冷语、极冷语、嘲笑、极嘲笑、恶口、极恶口、恶宣传、阴口，
Abusing of others, disparaging, reproaching, snubbing, continual snubbing, ridicule, continual ridicule, denigration, continual denigration, tale-bearing, backbiting, on the part of one bent on gain, honour and renown, of one of evil wishes, a prey to wishes--
是名嗔骂示相。
this is called belittling.


什么是以利求利？
65.”Herein, what is pursuing gain with gain? 
即为利养、恭敬、名誉所执着的恶欲者、及为欲所败者，将此处所得之物拿到彼处，或将彼处所得之物拿到此处，如是以（甲）物而希求、贪求、遍求、希望、贪望、遍望于（乙）物，
Seeking, seeking for, seeking out, going in search of, searching for, searching out material goods by means of material goods, such as carrying there goods that have been got from here, or carrying here goods that have been got from there, by one bent on gain, honour and renown, by one of evil wishes, a prey to wishes--
是名以利求利”。
this is called pursuing gain with gain.” (Vibh 352–53)


当知这些圣典的文句亦有如下的意义。
66.The meaning of this text should be understood as follows: 

先释关于诡诈的一节：
Firstly, as regards description of scheming: 
“利养恭敬名誉所执着者”，是执着希求于利养恭敬及名誉的意思。
on the part of one bent on gain, honour and renown is on the part of one who is bent on gain, on honour, and on reputation; on the part of one who longs for them, is the meaning. 

“恶欲者”，
Of one of evil wishes: 
是无道德而欲示其有道德者。
of one who wants to show qualities that he has not got. 

“为欲所败者”，
A prey to wishes: 
是为欲所击败而被征服的意思。
the meaning is, of one who is attacked by them. 


此后的拒绝资具、迂回之说、假肃威仪的三种诡诈之事，因为是来自《大义释》，所以现在来显示此三事也用所谓拒绝资具等开始而加以说明。
And after this the passage beginning or by what is called rejection of requisites is given in order to show the three instances of scheming given in the Mahaaniddesa as rejection of requisites, indirect talk, and that based on deportment.


兹有欲以衣服等作布施者，
他（比丘）的心里虽然很想那些东西，
但因本于他的恶欲而加以拒绝，
67.Herein, [a bhikkhu] is invited to accept robes, etc., and, precisely because he wants them, he refuses them out of evil wishes. 
等到知道了诸居士业已笃信自己，并且他们屡屡这样说：
And then, since he knows that those householders believe in him implicitly when they think, 
“啊！尊者少欲，不欲接受我们的任何东西，
“Oh, how few are our lord’s wishes! He will not accept a thing!” 
如果他能接受一点什么，实为我们的极大功德”，
【此段文字英譯本所無。】
于是用种种方法去表示为了怜悯他们的愿望而接受他拿来的上等的衣服等物。
and they put fine robes, etc., before him by various means, he then accepts, making a show that he wants to be compassionate towards them--
此后便使居士们惊喜，甚至用车辆运东西来供养了。
it is this hypocrisy of his, which becomes the cause of their subsequently bringing them even by cartloads, 
当知是名拒绝资具诡诈事。
that should be understood as the instance of scheming called rejection of requisites.

即如《大义释》中说：
68.For this is said in the Mahaaniddesa: 
“什么称为拒绝资具诡诈事？
“What is the instance of scheming called rejection of requisites? 
今有居士，邀请比丘，
Here householders invite bhikkhus 
以衣服、
[to accept] robes, 
饮食、
alms food, 
住所、
resting place, 
医药作供养，
and the requisite of medicine as cure for the sick. 
然彼恶欲者，
One who is of evil wishes, 
为欲所败者，
a prey to wishes, 
因为欲求更多的衣服……等，
wanting robes … alms food … resting place … the requisite of medicine as cure for the sick, 
所以拒绝接受他们所施的衣服、
refuses robes … 
饮食、
alms food … 
住所
resting place … 
及医药，
the requisite of medicine as cure for the sick, because he wants more. 
而且这样说：
He says: 
‘沙门为什么要用高价衣服？
‘What has an ascetic to do with expensive robes? 
最适合于沙门的是从坟墓、垃圾堆或店前拾集所弃的碎布来作僧伽梨衣穿。
It is proper for an ascetic to gather rags from a charnel ground or from a rubbish heap or from a shop and make them into a patchwork cloak to wear. 
沙门为什么要用上等的饮食？
What has an ascetic to do with expensive alms food? 
最适合于沙门的是以行乞一团之食来维持其生命。
It is proper for an ascetic to get his living by the dropping of lumps [of food into his bowl] while he wanders for gleanings.
沙门为什么要用上等的住所？
What has an ascetic to do with an expensive resting place? 
最适合于沙门的是在树下或露地而住。
It is proper for an ascetic to be a tree-root-dweller or an open-air-dweller. 
沙门为什么要用高贵的医药？
What has an ascetic to do with an expensive requisite of medicine as cure for the sick? 
最适合于沙门的是用牛的尿或一片诃梨勒果作药品’。
It is proper for an ascetic to cure himself with putrid urine and broken gallnuts.’ 
于是他便穿粗糙的衣服，
Accordingly he wears a coarse robe, 
吃粗糙的饮食，
eats coarse alms food, 
受用粗糙的住所，
uses a coarse resting place, 
受用粗糙的医药。
uses a coarse requisite of medicine as cure for the sick. 
使居士们知道了他这样说：
Then householders think, 
‘此沙门是
‘This ascetic 
少欲
has few wishes, 
知足者，
is content, 
隐居者，
is secluded, 
不与众杂住者，
keeps aloof from company, 
勤精进者，
is strenuous, 
头陀行者’。
is a preacher of asceticism,’ 
如是他们便常常邀请而供以衣服等受用之物。
and they invite him more and more [to accept] robes, alms food, resting places, and the requisite of medicine as cure for the sick. 
他便这样说：
He says: 
‘具信善男子，三事现前，必生多福，
‘With three things present a faithful clansman produces much merit: 
即有信现前，
with faith present a faithful clansman produces much merit, 
有所施之物现前，
with goods to be given present a faithful clansman produces much merit, 
有应施之人现前，具信善男子必生多福。
with those worthy to receive present a faithful clansman produces much merit. 
你们便是有信者，
You have faith; 
并有所施之物在此，
the goods to be given are here; 
又有我是受者。
and I am here to accept. 
如果我不接受你们的，
If I do not accept, 
你们便无福德了。
then you will be deprived of the merit. 
然而我实不需此等东西，。
That is no good to me. 
但为怜悯你们，只好收受了’
Rather will I accept out of compassion for you.” 
此后则许多衣服、
Accordingly he accepts many robes, 
饮食、
he accepts much alms food, 
住所、
he accepts many resting places, 
医药也都收受了。
he accepts many requisites of medicine as cure for the sick. 
谁是这样颦眉、
Such grimacing, 
蹙额、
grimacery, 
诡诈、
scheming, 
虚伪、
schemery, 
欺诈的，
schemedness, 
便是称为拒绝资具的诡诈事”。
is known as the instance of scheming called rejection of requisites’ (Nidd I 224–25).


恶欲者为欲表示自己证得上人法，用种种的说法而令人惊喜，称为迂回之谈的诡诈事。
69.It is hypocrisy on the part of one of evil wishes, who gives it to be understood verbally in some way or other that he has attained a higher than human state, that should be understood as the instance of scheming called indirect talk, 
即所谓：
according as it is said: 
“什么称为迂回之谈的诡诈事？
“What is the instance of scheming called indirect talk? 
今有恶欲者、
Here someone of evil wishes, 
为欲所败者，
a prey to wishes, 
欲求人们恭敬，
eager to be admired, [thinking] ‘Thus people will admire me’ 
假依圣人的法语作如是说：
speaks words about the noble state. 
‘穿这样衣服的沙门，则为一大有能力者。
He says, ‘He who wears such a robe is a very important ascetic.’ 
用这样的钵、
He says, ‘He who carries such a bowl, 
铜碗、
metal cup, 
水瓶、
water filler, 
滤水囊、
water strainer, 
钥、
key, 
带、
wears such a waist band, 
履等的沙门为一大有能力者。
sandals, is a very important ascetic.’ 
有这样的和尚，
He says, ‘He who has such a preceptor … 
阿阇黎，
teacher … 
同一和尚
who has the same preceptor, 
同一阿阇黎的
who has the same teacher, 
朋友、
who has such a friend, 
知己、
intimate, 
同伴的沙门，为一大有能力者。
companion; 
住这样的精舍、
he who lives in such a monastery, 
半边屋（仅盖半边的）、
lean-to, 
台观（筑于高处而方形的）、
mansion, 
大厦（一种长而有上层房室的大厦）、
villa, 
石窟（自然的）、
cave, 
洞穴（人造而有门的）、
grotto, 
小屋、
hut, 
重阁、
pavilion, 
望楼（可瞭望的）、
watch tower, 
圆屋（多角形的）、
hall, 
长屋（仅有一堂一门的长屋）、
barn, 
集会所、
meeting hall, 
假屋（临时盖的房屋或礼堂等）、
room, 
树下，
at such a tree root, 
则彼沙门实为一大有能力者’。
is a very important ascetic.’ 
或者此等为恶所染者，
Or alternatively, all-gushing, 
屡屡颦蹙、
all-grimacing, 
大事欺诈、
all-scheming, 
饶舌不已，
all-talkative, with an expression of admiration, 
故意说些甚深、
he utters such deep, 
秘密、
mysterious, 
微妙、
cunning, 
隐微、
obscure, 
出世间、
supramundane talk 
空相应的议论，
suggestive of voidness as 
然后连接他的议论而假以口头恭敬于人说：‘这样的沙门，实已得住禅定’。
‘This ascetic is an obtainer of peaceful abidings and attainments such as these.’ 
象这样颦眉、蹙额、诡诈、虚伪、欺诈的，便称为迂回之谈的诡诈事”。
Such grimacing, grimacery, scheming, schemery, schemedness, is known as the instance of scheming called indirect talk” (Nidd I 226–27).


其次恶欲者为求恭敬，假以威仪令人惊异，
70.It is hypocrisy on the part of one of evil wishes, which takes the form of deportment influenced by eagerness to be admired, 
便是假肃威仪诡诈事。
that should be understood as the instance of scheming dependent on deportment, 
即所谓：“什么称为威仪诡诈事？
according as it is said: “What is the instance of scheming called deportment? 
今有恶欲者、
Here someone of evil wishes, 
为欲所败者，
a prey to wishes, 
为求恭敬，
eager to be admired, 
并以为如此做法可能获得人们的恭敬，
[thinking] ‘Thus people will admire me,’ 
便假肃行、
composes his way of walking, 
住、坐、
【此處英譯無】
卧，
composes his way of lying down; 
好象有深切愿求（圣果）似的行、
he walks studiedly, 
住、
stands studiedly, 
坐、
sits studiedly, 
卧，
lies down studiedly; 
又好象深入三昧似的行、
he walks as though concentrated, 
立、
stands, 
坐、
sits, 
卧，
lies down as though concentrated; 
或者故意在人们看见的地方修禅定，
and he is one who meditates in public. 
象这样作威仪的
Such disposing, 
装束，
posing, 
做作、
composing, 
矫饰、
of deportment, 
颦眉、
grimacing, 
蹙额、
grimacery, 
诡诈、
scheming, 
虚伪、
schemery, 
欺诈，
schemedness, 
便称为威仪诡诈事”。
is known as the instance of scheming called deportment” (Nidd I 225–26).


这里的“称为拒绝资具”，
71.Herein, the words by what is called rejection of requisites (§61) mean: 
是所谓拒绝资具
by what is called thus “rejection of requisites”; 
或者仅以名为拒绝资具的意思。
or they mean: by means of the rejection of requisites that is so called. 

“迂回之说”是用近乎说法的意思。
By indirect talk means: by talking near to the subject. 

“威仪”即四威仪（行住坐卧）。
Of deportment means: of the four modes of deportment (postures). 

“装束”是预先的布置
Disposing is initial posing, 
或尊重的布置。
or careful posing. 

“做作”是形式的布置。
Posing is the manner of posing. 

“矫饰”是加以完善布置（装模作样）而令人喜乐的状态。
Composing is prearranging; assuming a trust-inspiring attitude, is what is meant. 

“颦眉”、为了表示他是高度的精勤而故作颦眉之状及收缩其嘴脸。
Grimacing is making grimaces by showing great intenseness; facial contraction is what is meant. One who has the habit of making grimaces is a grimacer. 

常作颦蹙的状态为“蹙额”。
The grimacer’s state is grimacery. 

“诡诈”为欺骗。
Scheming is hypocrisy. 

诡诈的制造为“虚伪”。
The way (aayanaa) of a schemer (kuha) is schemery (kuhaayanaa).

作诡诈的状态为“欺诈”。
The state of what is schemed is schemedness.


对于“虚谈”的解释：
72.In the description of talking: 

“无问虚谈”，例如他看见了俗人来到精舍，便如是先作空谈：
talking at is talking thus on seeing people coming to the monastery, 
“你为什么目的到这里来？
“What have you come for, good people? 
邀请比丘吗？
What, to invite bhikkhus? 
如果这样，你先回去，
If it is that, then go along 
我将取钵随后而来”；
and I shall come later with [my bowl],” etc.; 
或作自我介绍说：
or alternatively, talking at is talking by advertising oneself thus, 
“我名帝须，
“I am Tissa, 
国王信仰我，
the king trusts me, such 
某某等大臣也很信仰我”，象这样的自说即为无问虚谈。
and such king’s ministers trust me.” 

“虚谈”是被人询问之后而说象前面这些话。
Talking is the same kind of talking on being asked a question. 

深恐居士们有恶感，屡屡让他们有说话机会而作巧妙的虚谈为“极虚谈”。
Talking round is roundly talking by one who is afraid of householders’ displeasure because he has given occasion for it. 

如说“大富者、大船主、大施主”等抬举的虚谈为“赞虚谈”。
Talking up is talking by extolling people thus, “He is a great land-owner, a great ship-owner, a great lord of giving.” 

由各方面来作抬举的虚谈为“极赞虚谈”。
Continual talking up is talking by extolling [people] in all ways.

“缠络语”，如说：“优婆塞啊！上年此时，你曾作尝新的布施，现在你为什么不作供施呢”？用这样的话重重的缠而裹之，
73.Persuading is progressively involving [people] thus, “Lay followers, formerly you used to give first-fruit alms at such a time; why do you not do so now?” 
直至他这样的回答：
until they say, 
“尊者，我们要供施的，不过未得机会而已”。
“We shall give, venerable sir, we have had no opportunity,” etc.; entangling, is what is meant. 
或者见人手拿甘蔗，便问道：
Or alternatively, seeing someone with sugarcane in his hand, he asks, 
“优婆塞啊！这甘蔗从哪里拿来的”？
“Where are you coming from, lay follower?”--
“尊者，从甘蔗田里拿来的”。
“From the sugarcane field, venerable sir”--
“那甘蔗是甜的吗”？
“Is the sugarcane sweet there?”--
“尊者，这要尝了之后才能知道的”。
“One can find out by eating, venerable sir”--
“然而叫你把甘蔗送给我，这话是不合于比丘说的”。
“It is not allowed, lay follower, for bhikkhus to say ‘Give [me some] sugarcane.’” 
用这种纠缠的话去裹住所欲推辞的人，名为缠络语。
Such entangling talk from such an entangler is persuading. 

从各方面重重应用缠络语为“极缠络语”。
Persuading again and again in all ways is continual persuading.

如说：“这家人只知道我，如果他们有所布施之物，只有给我的”，象这样抬举的表示为“举说”。
74.Suggesting is insinuating by specifying thus, “That family alone understands me; if there is anything to be given there, they give it to me only”; pointing to, is what is meant. 
特罗根达利迦故事亦可在这里解说。
And here the story of the oil-seller should be told.

从各方面常作抬举之说为“极举说”。
Suggesting in all ways again and again is continual suggesting.

“随爱语”，为不顾是否契合于理或契合于法，只是说些令人喜爱的话。
75.Ingratiating chatter is endearing chatter repeated again and again without regard to whether it is in conformity with truth and Dhamma. 

“谄谀”是卑下的行动，
Flattery is speaking humbly, 
说话时总是把自己放得极低的地位。
always maintaining an attitude of inferiority. 

“豆汤语”，意为象豆汤一样，
Bean-soupery is resemblance to bean soup; 
譬如煮过的绿豆，有些是不可能煮熟的，
for just as when beans are being cooked only a few do not get cooked, 
其余的则熟了，
the rest get cooked, 
同样的，他说的话，有一部分是真的，
so too the person in whose speech only a little is true, 
其余的却是虚妄的，
the rest being false, 
这样的人称为豆汤者，
is called a “bean soup”; 
他的状态就象豆汤一样。
his state is bean-soupery.

“养育状”，意为养育的状态，
76. Fondling is the state of the act of fondling. 
他好象家庭的乳母，用腰或背而抱负。
For when a man fondles children on his lap or on his shoulder like a nurse--
其养育的行为是养育业，
he nurses, is the meaning--that fondler’s act is the act of fondling. 
其养育的状态为养育状。
The state of the act of fondling is fondling.





关于“现相”一节的解释：
77. In the description of hinting (nemittikataa)：
“示相”是用身口的动作而促使别人生起以资具供养之想。
a sign (nimitta) is any bodily or verbal act that gets others to give requisites. 
譬如看见来人手持饮食，便问道：“你得了些什么可吃的吗”？以此等暗示的动作而希求所需的为“示相业”。
Giving a sign is making a sign such as “What have you got to eat?”, etc., on seeing [people] going along with food. 

“暗示”，是说些与布施资具有关的话。
Indication is talk that alludes to requisites. 

“暗示业”，好象他看见放犊牛的牧童问道：“这些犊子是母牛的乳犊，还是吸薄酪的犊”？
Giving indication: on seeing cowboys, he asks, “Are these milk cows’ calves or buttermilk cows’ calves?” 
“尊者，它们还是乳犊啦”！
and when it is said, “They are milk cows’ calves, venerable sir,” 
“唔！恐怕不是吧？如果它们是乳犊，则比丘亦可获得其母牛之乳的”，
[he remarks] “They are not milk cows’ calves. If they were milk cows’ calves the bhikkhus would be getting milk,” etc.; 
由于这些暗示的动作促使牧童们归告其父母而供以牛乳。
and his getting it to the knowledge of the boys’ parents in this way, and so making them give milk, is giving indication.


“迂回谈”，是相近之说。
78. Indirect talk is talk that keeps near [to the subject]. 
这里当举一位与一人家很亲近的比丘故事以示此意。
And here there should be told the story of the bhikkhu supported by a family. 
据说：一位和某人家很亲近的比丘，欲求饭食而进入他的家中坐着。
A bhikkhu, it seems, who was supported by a family went into the house wanting to eat and sat down. 
主妇看见了他不欲给以饭食而故意地说：
The mistress of the house was unwilling to give. On seeing him she said, 
“一点米也没有了啊”！
“There is no rice,” 
但她装着要借米的样子跑到邻家去了。
and she went to a neighbour’s house as though to get rice. 
于是这比丘便入内室去看看，
The bhikkhu went into the storeroom. Looking round, 
在门角里发现了一些甘蔗，
he saw sugarcane in the corner behind the door, 
瓮中有砂糖，
sugar in a bowl, 
篮中有一块盐干鱼，
a string of salt fish in a basket, 
缸中有米，
rice in a jar, 
瓶中有酪，
and ghee in a pot. 
他见了之后依然跑出来坐于原处。
He came out and sat down. 
未几，主妇回来说：
When the housewife came back, she said, 
“没有借得米啦”！
“I did not get any rice.” 
比丘说：
The bhikkhu said, 
”优婆夷，今天我曾见一预兆，知道不能获得午餐的”。
“Lay follower, I saw a sign just now that alms will not be easy to get today.”--
“尊者，怎样的”？
“What, venerable sir?”--
“我曾见一条象那门角里的甘蔗一样的蛇，
“I saw a snake that was like sugarcane put in the corner behind the door; 
为了要打它，找了一块象那瓮中的砂糖一样的石头，
looking for something to hit it with, I saw a stone like a lump of sugar in a bowl. 
当打它时，那蛇鼓胀其颈恰如篮中的盐干鱼一样，
When the snake had been hit with the clod, it spread out a hood like a string of salt fish in a basket, 
张口欲去咬那块石头而暴露的牙齿恰如那缸中的米一样，
and its teeth as it tried to bite the clod were like rice grains in a jar. 
由于它的愤怒而流出的毒液正如那瓶中的乳酪一样”。
Then the saliva mixed with poison that came out to its mouth in its fury was like ghee put in a pot.” 
她想：“实在无法欺瞒这秃头了”！
She thought, “There is no hoodwinking the shaveling,” 
于是便给他甘蔗、煮饭、烧鱼并给以糖及酪等的一切。
so she gave him the sugarcane [29] and she cooked the rice and gave it all to him with the ghee, the sugar and the fish. 
作此等相近之说而欲有所得的为“迂回谈”。
