79.Such talk that keeps near [to the subject] should be understood as indirect talk. 


“曲折说”，老是曲曲折折的盘绕而说，直至获得他所需求的为止。
Roundabout talk is talking round and round [the subject] as much as is allowed.



对于“嗔骂示相”一节的解释：
80.In the description of belittling: 

“怒骂”即以十种怒骂事而怒骂。
abusing is abusing by means of the ten instances of abuse.

“侮蔑”即说轻蔑侮辱的话。
Disparaging is contemptuous talk. 

“呵责”为举人的过失而叫他
Reproaching is enumeration of faults such as 
“不信者、
“He is faithless, 
不信乐者”等语。
he is an unbeliever.” 

“冷语”，
Snubbing is taking up verbally thus, 
如说“不要在这里说这话”等的冷语。
“Don’t say that here.” 

从各方面举出根据及理由而冷言之为“极冷语”。
Snubbing in all ways, giving grounds and reasons, is continual snubbing. 

或者看见不肯布施的人说
Or alternatively, when someone does not give, taking him up thus, 
“施主呀！”等的冷言为“冷语”。
“Oh, the prince of givers!” is snubbing; 

若说“大施主呀！”等的极冷之言为“极冷语”。
and the thorough snubbing thus, “A mighty prince of givers!” is continual snubbing. 

“什么是此人的生命？他是食种子者”，如是讥笑于人为“嘲笑”。
Ridicule is making fun of someone thus, “What sort of a life has this man who eats up his seed [grain]?” 

“你说此人不肯布施吗？他时常能送给你一句‘没有’的”，如此极度讥讽人家为“极嘲笑”。
Continual ridicule is making fun of him more thoroughly thus, “What, you say this man is not a giver who always gives the words ‘There is nothing’ to everyone?”


公开骂人为吝啬者或无可赞美者是“恶口”。
81. Denigration is denigrating someone by saying that he is not a giver, or by censuring him. 

从各方面而恶口者为“极恶口”。
All-round denigration is continual denigration. 

“恶宣传”，他以为‘别人将会恐怖我的恶批评而布施我的’，于是从家至家，从村至村，从地方至地方的从事恶宣传。
Tale-bearing is bearing tales from house to house, from village to village, from district to district, [thinking] “So they will give to me out of fear of my bearing tales.” 

“阴口”，意为当面给以甜言蜜语，背后则恶意诋毁，
Backbiting is speaking censoriously behind another’s back after speaking kindly to his face; 
犹如不见其面时，便吃他的背肉，故名阴口。
for this is like biting the flesh of another’s back, when he is not looking, on the part of one who is unable to look him in the face; therefore it is called backbiting. 

此等名为“嗔骂示相”，
This is called belittling (nippesikataa) 
因为他刮去别人的善德，象用一竹片刮去身上所涂的膏药一样，
because it scrapes off (nippeseti), wipes off, the virtuous qualities of others as a bamboo scraper (ve.lupesikaa) does unguent, 
或如捣碎各种香料而求取香味，他以捣碎他人的善德而求取利益，
or because it is a pursuit of gain by grinding (nippi.msitvaa) and pulverizing others’ virtuous qualities, like the pursuit of perfume by grinding perfumed substances; 
故名嗔骂示相。
that is why it is called belittling.


对于“以利求利”一节的解释：
82.`In the description of pursuing gain with gain: 

“求”是追寻之意。
`pursuing is hunting after. 

“从此处所得之物”，意为从此户人家所得的东西。
Got from here is got from this house. 

“彼处”，指那户人家而言。
There is into that house. 

“希求”为欲求。
Seeking is wanting. 

“贪求”为追求。
Seeking for is hunting after. 

“遍求”为再再追求。
Seeking out is hunting after again and again. [30] 

这里当提及某一比丘的故事：他从最初的人家获得所施的食物，分送给这里那里的人家的孩子们，终于获得了乳粥而去。
The story of the bhikkhu who went round giving away the alms he had got at first to children of families here and there and in the end got milk and gruel should be told here. 

希望，即希求等的同义语，
Searching, etc., are synonyms for “seeking,” etc., and so the construction here should be understood thus: 

如是则希求为“希望”，
going in search of is seeking; 

贪求为“贪望”，
searching for is seeking for; 

遍求为“遍望”。
searching out is seeking out.

这便是诡诈等的意义。
This is the meaning of scheming, and so on.


现在来说“等恶法”：
83.Now, [as regards the words] The evil states beginning with (§42): 
这里的“等”字，
here the words beginning with should be understood to include the many evil states given in the Brahmajaala Sutta in the way beginning, 
即“或有沙门、婆罗门、
“Or just as some worthy ascetics, 
彼等食信施食，
while eating the food given by the faithful, 
依然用下贱的伎俩而生活于不正的生活中，
make a living by wrong livelihood, by such low arts as these, 
如相手、
that is to say, by palmistry, 
占卜预兆、
by fortune-telling, 
谈天地变易、
by divining omens, 
占梦、
by interpreting dreams, 
看相、
marks on the body, 
占鼠咬破布、
holes gnawed by mice; 
火供、
by fire sacrifice, 
匙的献供”等，
by spoon oblation 
如《梵网经》中所包摄的种种恶法。
…” (D I 9).


如是由于违犯为活命之因而制定的六学处（的生活）
84.So this wrong livelihood entails the transgression of these six training precepts announced on account of livelihood, and it entails the evil states beginning with 
及以诡诈、
“Scheming, 
虚谈、
talking, 
现相，
hinting, 
嗔骂示相、
belittling, 
以利求利等诸恶法所维持的生活为邪命，
pursuing gain with gain.” 
若能离此诸种邪命，
And so it is the abstinence from all sorts of wrong livelihood that 
即名活命遍净戒。
is virtue of livelihood purification, 


再来解释（活命遍净的）语义：
the word-meaning of which is this: 
依此来生活为“活命”。
on account of it they live, thus it is livelihood. 
那是什么？
What is that? 
即努力寻求于资具。
It is the effort consisting in the search for requisites. 
“遍净”为遍达于净性。
“Purification” is purifiedness. 
遍净的生活为“活命遍净”。
“Livelihood purification” is purification of livelihood.


（Ⅳ）资具依止戒
85. (d) As regards the next kind called virtue concerning requisites, 

此后（如理抉择，受用衣服，仅为防护寒热，防护虻、蚊、风、炎、爬行类之触，仅为遮蔽羞部。
[here is the text: “Reflecting wisely, he uses the robe only for protection from cold, for protection from heat, for protection from contact with gadflies, flies, wind, burning and creeping things, and only for the purpose of concealing the private parts. 
如理抉择，受用团食，不为嬉戏，不为骄慢，不为装饰，不为庄严，仅为此身住续维持，为止害，为助梵行，如是思惟：“我乃以此令灭旧受（之苦），不起新受（之苦）；我将存命、无过、安住”。
Reflecting wisely, he uses alms food neither for amusement nor for intoxication nor for smartening nor for embellishment, but only for the endurance and continuance of this body, for the ending of discomfort, and for assisting the life of purity: ‘Thus I shall put a stop to old feelings and shall not arouse new feelings, and I shall be healthy and blameless and live in comfort.’ 
如理抉择，受用床座，仅为防护寒热，防护虻、蚊、风、炎、爬行类之触，仅为避免季候之危，而好独坐（禅思）之乐。
Reflecting wisely, he uses the resting place only for the purpose of protection from cold, for protection from heat, for protection from contact with gadflies, flies, wind, burning and creeping things, and only for the purpose of warding off the perils of climate and enjoying retreat. 
如理抉择，受用医药资具，仅为防护生病恼受，而至究竟无苦而已。)是说资具依止戒。
Reflecting wisely, he uses the requisite of medicine as cure for the sick only for protection from arisen hurtful feelings and for complete immunity from affliction” (M I 10). 


（一、衣服）“如理抉择”，
Herein, reflecting wisely 
是知道以方便之道去抉择、
is reflecting as the means and as the way;
善知观察之意。
by knowing, by reviewing, is the meaning. 
这里所提示的“为防寒冷”等的观察，
And here it is the reviewing stated in the way beginning, “For protection from cold” that should be understood as 
便是如理抉择。
“reflecting wisely.”

“衣服”是指内衣等的任何一种。
86. Herein, the robe is any one of those beginning with the inner cloth. He uses: he employs; dresses in [as inner cloth], or puts on [as upper garment]. 

“仅”是表示区限目的之辞，
Only [31] is a phrase signifying invariability in the definition of a limit of a purpose; 
修行者使用衣服的目的，
the purpose in the meditator’s making use of the robes 
仅限于防护寒冷等，别无他意。
is that much only, namely, protection from cold, etc., not more than that. 

“寒”
From cold: 
是由自身内界的扰乱（内四大不调）
from any kind of cold arisen either through disturbance of elements internally 
或由外界气候变化所起的任何一种寒冷。
or through change in temperature externally. 

“防护”即防止，
For protection: 
意为除去寒冷
for the purpose of warding off; for the purpose of eliminating it so that it may not arouse affliction in the body. 
而使身体不生疾病；
For when the body is afflicted by cold, 
因为寒冷侵害其身，则内心散乱，不能如理精勤，
the distracted mind cannot be wisely exerted. 
故世尊听许使用衣服以防护寒冷。
That is why the Blessed One permitted the robe to be used for protection from cold. 
这种说法亦可通用下面各句（此后只说明其不同之处）。
So in each instance, 

“热”为火热，
except that from heat means from the heat of fire, 
如森林着火等所生的热。
the origin of which should be understood as forest fires, and so on.

“虻蚊风炎爬行类之触”。
87.From contact with gadflies and flies, wind and burning and creeping things: 
这里的“虻”是啮蝇和盲蝇。
here gadflies are flies that bite; they are also called “blind flies.” 
“蚊”即蚊子。
Flies are just flies. 
“风”是有尘及无尘等类的风。
Wind is distinguished as that with dust and that without dust.
“炎”是阳光的炎热。
Burning is burning of the sun. 
“爬行类”即蛇等匍匐而行的长虫。
Creeping things are any long creatures such as snakes and so on that move by crawling. 
“触”有啮触及接触二种。若披衣而坐者则不受此等之害，在这种情形下，故为防护彼等而受用衣服。
Contact with them is of two kinds: contact by being bitten and contact

其次更提“仅”字，
88.Only: the word 
是再决定区限使用衣服的目的。
is repeated in order to define a subdivision of the invariable purpose; 
遮蔽羞部是使用衣服的决定目的，
for the concealment of the private parts is an invariable purpose; 
其他的目的是有时间性的。
the others are purposes periodically. 

“羞部”是他们（男女）的隐秘之处，
Herein, private parts are any parts of the pudendum. 
因为暴露此等部分，则扰乱及破坏于羞耻，
For when a member is disclosed, conscience (hiri) is disturbed (kuppati), offended. 
以其能乱羞耻，故名羞部。
It is called “private parts” (hirikopiina) because of the disturbance of conscience (hiri-kopana). 
其羞部的遮蔽为遮蔽羞部，
For the purpose of concealing the private parts: for the purpose of the concealment of those private parts. 
有些地方亦作遮蔽于羞部。
[As well as the reading “hiriko-piina-pa.ticchaadanattha.m] there is a reading “hirikopiina.m pa.ticchaadanattha.m.”



（二、食物）“团食”即指各种食物。
89. Alms food is any sort of food. 
由于彼比丘的行乞而一团一团的落在钵内的各种食物为团食，
For any sort of nutriment is called “alms food” (pi.n.dapaata—lit. “lump-dropping”) because of its having been dropped (patitattaa) into a bhikkhu’s bowl during his alms round (pi.n.dolya). 
或一团团的降落故为团食，
Or alms food (pi.n.dapaata) is the dropping (paata) of the lumps (pi.n.da); 
即指从各处所受的施食。
it is the concurrence (sannipaata), the collection, of alms (bhikkhaa) obtained here and there, is what is meant.

“不为嬉戏”，
Neither for amusement: 
不象乡村的孩子那样专为嬉戏游玩。
neither for the purpose of amusement, as with village boys, etc.; for the sake of sport, is what is meant. 

“不为骄慢”，
Nor for intoxication: 
不象拳师和力士等那样为的骄态，
not for the purpose of intoxication, as with boxers, etc.; 
亦即不为勇力的骄态及强壮的骄态。
for the sake of intoxication with strength and for the sake of intoxication with manhood, is what is meant. [32] 

“不为装饰”，
Nor for smartening: 
不象宫女、妓女等为的需要装饰，
not for the purpose of smartening, as with royal concubines, courtesans, etc.; 
需要其肢体的丰满艳丽。
for the sake of plumpness in all the limbs, is what is meant. 

“不为庄严”，
Nor for embellishment: 
不象优人舞女那样为着皮肤的色泽光润美丽。
not for the purpose of embellishment, as with actors, dancers, etc.; for the sake of a clear skin and complexion, is what is meant.

进一层说，“不为嬉戏”，
90. And here the clause neither for amusement 
是舍断痴的近因。
is stated for the purpose of abandoning support for delusion; 

“不为骄慢”，
nor for intoxication 
是舍断嗔的近因。
is said for the purpose of abandoning support for hate; 

“不为装饰，不为庄严”，
nor for smartening nor for embellishment 
是舍断贪欲的近因。
is said for the purpose of abandoning support for greed. 

又“不为嬉戏，不为骄慢，
And neither for amusement nor for intoxication 
是阻止生起自己的结缠。
is said for the purpose of preventing the arising of fetters for oneself. 

“不为装饰，不为庄严”，
Nor for smartening nor for embellishment 
是阻止他人的结缠生起。
is said for the purpose of preventing the arising of fetters for another. 

这四句亦可说为弃舍沉溺于欲乐及不如理的行道。
And the abandoning of both unwise practice and devotion to indulgence of sense pleasures should be understood as stated by these four. 

更提“仅”字之意已如前说。
Only has the meaning already stated.

“此身”，
91.Of this body: 
即此四大种（地水火风）所成的色身。
of this material body consisting of the four great primaries. 

“住续”，是使其继续存在之意。
For the endurance: for the purpose of continued endurance. 

“维持”
And continuance: 
是不断的活动
for the purpose of not interrupting [life’s continued] occurrence, 
或长时存续之意。
or for the purpose of endurance for a long time. 
因彼（比丘）受用食物以住续及维持其身体，
He makes use of the alms food for the purpose of the endurance, for the purpose of the continuance, of the body, 
犹如老屋之主（以支柱）支持其屋，
as the owner of an old house uses props for his house, 
或如车主涂油于车轴一样，
and as a carter uses axle grease, 
并非为嬉戏，
not for the purpose of amusement, 
为骄慢，
intoxication, 
为装饰，
smartening, 
为庄严的。
and embellishment. 
且住续与命根同义，
Furthermore, endurance is a term for the life faculty. 
所以为此身住续维持，
So what has been said as far as the words for the endurance and continuance of this body can be understood to mean: 
亦可以说为使此身的命根继续存在。
for the purpose of maintaining the occurrence of the life faculty in this body.


“为止害”，
92. For the ending of discomfort: 
这里的“害”是为饥饿所恼害。
hunger is called “discomfort” in the sense of afflicting. 
比丘受用食物以除饥饿，
He makes use of alms food for the purpose of ending that, 
犹如敷药于疮伤之处和对治寒暑等一样。
like anointing a wound, like counteracting heat with cold, and so on. 

“为助梵行”，
For assisting the life of purity: 
是为助益全佛教的梵行
for the purpose of assisting the life of purity consisting in the whole dispensation 
及道的梵行。
and the life of purity consisting in the path. 
于是行道者之受用食物，是为借助体力而勤修于三学（戒定慧），以渡有的沙漠；
For while this [bhikkhu] is engaged in crossing the desert of existence by means of devotion to the three trainings depending on bodily strength whose necessary condition is the use of alms food, 
或者为了勤修梵行而受用食物，犹如为渡沙漠（绝粮）的人而食其子之肉，
he makes use of it to assist the life of purity just as those seeking to cross the desert used their child’s flesh, 
如渡河者以筏，
just as those seeking to cross a river use a raft, and 
渡海者用船一样。
just as those seeking to cross the ocean use a ship.

“我乃以此令灭旧受，不起新受”，
93.Thus I shall put a stop to old feelings and shall not arouse new feelings: [33] 
是说他这样想：
thus as a sick man uses medicine, he uses [alms food, thinking]: 
“我现在受用这种食物，
“By use of this alms food 
为令除灭旧受的饥饿之苦，
I shall put a stop to the old feeling of hunger, 
并不由于无限的食下去而生起新的苦受，
and I shall not arouse a new feeling by immoderate eating, 
不象食之过多而借助他人之手拉他起立，
like one of the [proverbial] brahmans, that is, one who eats till he has to be helped up by hand, 
食之鼓腹以致不能穿衣，
or till his clothes will not meet, 
食之过多而跌卧在那里，
or till he rolls there [on the ground], 
食之充满至颈能为乌鸦啄取，
or till crows can peck from his mouth, 
食至呕吐而犹食的任何一种婆罗门那样、我实如病者用药一样”。
or until he vomits what he has eaten. 
或者现在因不适当及无限量的饮食所生起的苦痛是由于宿业之缘，故称“旧受”；
Or alternatively, there is that which is called ‘old feelings’ because, being conditioned by former kamma, it arises now in dependence on unsuitable immoderate eating—
我今以适当及适量之食，灭彼旧受之缘，而除旧受之苦。
I shall put a stop to that old feeling, forestalling its condition by suitable moderate eating. 
由于现在作不适当受用所积聚的业，将产生未来的新受之苦，故名“新受”；
And there is that which is called ‘new feeling’ because it will arise in the future in dependence on the accumulation of kamma consisting in making improper use [of the requisite of alms food] now—
我今以适当的受用，则新受的根本不再生起，而新受的苦痛也不生了。
I shall also not arouse that new feeling, avoiding by means of proper use the production of its root.” 
当知这也是这里的意思。
This is how the meaning should be understood here. 
以上二句是显示采取适当的受用，
What has been shown so far can be understood to include proper use [of requisites], 
舍断沉溺于苦行，
abandoning of devotion to self-mortification, 
不离于法乐。
and not giving up lawful bliss (pleasure).

“我将存命”，
94.And I shall be healthy: 
是他在受用食物之时作如是想：以有益适量的受用，则无断绝命根及破坏威仪的危险，所以我的身体将依食物而生存，犹如长病之人而受用医药一样。
“In this body, which exists in dependence on requisites, I shall, by moderate eating, have health called ‘long endurance’ since there will be no danger of severing the life faculty or interrupting the [continuity of the] postures.” 

“无过，安住”，
[Reflecting] in this way, he makes use [of the alms food] as a sufferer from a chronic disease does of his medicine. 
由于避去不适当的遍求领取及食用故“无过”；
And blameless and live in comfort (lit. “and have blamelessness and a comfortable abiding”): he makes use of them thinking: “I shall have blamelessness by avoiding improper search, acceptance and eating, 
由于适量的食用故“安住”。
and I shall have a comfortable abiding by moderate eating.” Or he does so thinking: 
或无因不适当及无限量的食缘而发生的
“I shall have blamelessness due to absence of such faults as 
不愉快、
boredom, 
欲睡、
sloth, 
呵欠伸腰、
sleepiness, 
为识者所呵责等的过失为“无过”；
blame by the wise, etc., that have unseemly immoderate eating as their condition; 
由于适当适量的食缘而增长其身力为“安住”。或者避免随其意欲而食之满腹，
and I shall have a comfortable abiding by producing bodily strength that has seemly moderate eating as its condition.” 
或弃横卧之乐、
Or he does so thinking: “I shall have blamelessness by abandoning the pleasure of lying down, 
展转侧卧之乐，
lolling 
睡眠之乐等为“无过”；
and torpor, through refraining from eating as much as possible to stuff the belly; 
由于少食四五口（不过饱），使四威仪相应而行道为“安住”。故我受用食物。
and I shall have a comfortable abiding by controlling the four postures through eating four or five mouthfuls less than the maximum.” 

正如这样说：
For this is said:
少食四五口，
With four or five lumps still to eat
汝即当饮水，
Let him then end by drinking water;
勤修习比丘，
For energetic bhikkhus’ needs
实足以安住。
This should suffice to live in comfort (Th 983). [34]
这（存命、无过、安住三句）是说明中道为（食的）根本目的。
Now, what has been shown at this point can be understood as discernment of purpose and practice of the middle way.


（三、床座）“床座”，
95.Resting place (senaasana): 
即卧所
this is the bed (sena) 
与坐处。
and seat (aasana). 
无论在精舍
For wherever one sleeps (seti), whether in a monastery 
或半边檐的盖屋中所卧的地方为卧所；
or in a lean-to, etc., that is the bed (sena); 
无论什么座席为坐处。
wherever one seats oneself (aasati), sits (nisiidati), that is the seat (aasana). 
把它们合成一起而说为床座。
Both together are called “resting-place” (or “abode”—senaasana).

“为避季候之危，而好独坐（禅思）之乐”，
For the purpose of warding off the perils of climate and enjoying retreat: 
以气候而有危险故为季候之危。
the climate itself in the sense of imperilling (parisahana) is “perils of climate” (utu-parissaya). 
为除去气候的危险及好独坐（禅思）的快乐，当以受用床座而得消除能使身体害病心地散乱的不适当的气候，
Unsuitable climatic conditions that cause mental distraction due to bodily affliction can be warded off by making use of the resting place; 
故说为除季候之危及好独坐（禅思）之乐。
it is for the purpose of warding off these and for the purpose of the pleasure of solitude, is what is meant. 
虽然为避季候之危，即指除去寒冷等而言，
Of course, the warding off of the perils of climate is stated by [the phrase] “protection from cold,” etc., too; 
但前面衣服的受用，是以遮蔽羞部为主要目的，
but, just as in the case of making use of the robes the concealment of the private parts is stated as an invariable purpose 
为防寒暑等仅为某些时间而已，
while the others are periodical [purposes], 
可是受用床座是以避免季候的危险为主要目的。
so here also this [last] should be understood as mentioned with reference to the invariable warding off of the perils of climate. 
季候之意已如前说。
Or alternatively, this “climate” of the kind stated is just climate; 
危险有显明
but “perils” are of two kinds: evident perils 
和隐匿的二种：
and concealed perils (see Nidd I 12). 
狮子猛虎等为显明的危险，
Herein, evident perils are lions, tigers, etc., 
贪嗔等为隐匿的危险。
while concealed perils are greed, hate, and so on. 
若无守护（如住树下等而有显危）及见不适当的色等（有隐险），则未免危害，而彼比丘既知如是观察而受用床座，
When a bhikkhu knows and reflects thus in making use of the kind of resting place where these [perils] do not, owing to unguarded doors and sight of unsuitable visible objects, etc., cause affliction, 
此乃如理抉择……为避季候之危而受用。
he can be understood as one who “reflecting wisely makes use of the resting place for the purpose of warding off the perils of climate.”


（四、医药）“医药”（病者的资具药品），这里的资具是治病之义，
96.The requisite of medicine as cure for the sick: here “cure” (paccaya = going against) is in the sense of going against (pati-ayana) illness; in the sense of countering, is the meaning. 
亦即与适合同义。
This is a term for any suitable remedy. 
由医生的工作所配合的为药。
It is the medical man’s work (bhisakkassa kamma.m) because it is permitted by him, thus it is medicine (bhesajja). 
病人的资具即药，
Or the cure for the sick itself as medicine is “medicine as cure for the sick.” 
故病者的资具药，即指医生所配合的任何适用于病人的
Any work of a medical man such as 
油
oil, 
蜜
honey, 
砂糖等而言。
ghee, etc., that is suitable for one who is sick, is what is meant. 

其次品字，在“以七种城市的戒备而善防护”等的意义中，则作防备说。
A “requisite” (parikkhaara), however, in such passages as “It is well supplied with the requisites of a city” (A IV 106) is equipment; 
又在“此车有戒的庄严，有定的轴勤的轮”等的意义中，则作庄严说。
in such passages as “The chariot has the requisite of virtue, the axle of jhāna, the wheel of energy” (S V 6) [35] it is an ornament; 
又在“出家者当集此等生活的资具等的意义中，则作必需品说。
in such passages as “The requisites for the life of one who has gone into homelessness that should be available” (M I 104), it is an accessory. 
在本文中，当取必需品和防备之义。
But here both equipment and accessory are applicable. 
以病者所需的药为防备生命，
For that medicine as a cure for the sick is equipment for maintaining life 
因为是保护其生命不给以生病灭亡的机会之故。
because it protects by preventing the arising of affliction destructive to life; 
同时以必需品得能长期生活，故说为防备。
and it is an accessory too because it is an instrument for prolonging life. That is why it is called “requisite.” 
如是以病者所需的药和防备品，说为病者的资具药品。
So it is medicine as cure for the sick and that is a requisite, thus it is a “requisite of medicine as cure for the sick.” 
病者的资具药品（医药）
[He makes use of] that requisite of medicine as cure for the sick; any requisite for life consisting of 
即指医生为病者所配合的任何适用的
油
oil, 
蜜
honey, 
砂糖
molasses, ghee, etc., 
that is allowed by a medical man as suitable for the sick, is what is meant.
等而防备其生命者。

“生”
97.From arisen: 
为生长或发生之意。
from born, become, produced. 

“病恼”，
Hurtful: 
恼是四界的变动（四大不调），因为从界的变化而生起
here “hurt (affliction)” is a disturbance of elements, 
疥癞
and it is the leprosy, 
发肿
tumours, 
脓疱等，
boils, etc., originated by that disturbance. 
故称病恼。
Hurtful (veyyaabaadhika) because arisen in the form of hurt (byaabaadha). 

“受”
Feelings: 
是苦受，
painful feelings, 
即不善异熟受，
feelings resulting from unprofitable kamma—
而为病恼受。
from those hurtful feelings. 

“至究竟无苦”，
For complete immunity from affliction: 
即至究竟不苦，
for complete freedom from pain; 
是为直至断除一切病苦（而受用医药）之意。
so that all that is painful is abandoned, is the meaning.

如是简要的如理抉择受用资具的特相，即为资具依止戒。
This is how this virtue concerning requisites should be understood. In brief its characteristic is the use of requisites after wise reflection. 
其（资具依止的）语义如次：
The word-meaning here is this: 
因为人类的来去活动是依赖于受用衣服等，
because breathing things go (ayanti), move, proceed, using [what they use] in dependence on these robes, etc., 
故名资具。
these robes, etc., are therefore called requisites (paccaya = ger. of paṭi + ayati); 
依止于资具，故称资具依止。
“concerning requisites” is concerning those requisites.


（杂论四遍净戒）
（一、别解脱律仪戒的成就）如是在四种戒中的别解脱律仪，须依于信而成就。
98. (a) So, in this fourfold virtue, Paatimokkha restraint has to be undertaken by means of faith. 
由信而成，
For that is accomplished by faith, 
因为制定学处是超越于声闻之权限的，
since the announcing of training precepts is outside the disciples’ province; 
如佛曾拒绝其弟子（关于制戒）的请求，可为这里的例证。
and the evidence here is the refusal of the request to [allow disciples to] announce training precepts (see Vin III 9–10). 
所以全部佛制的学处必须由信而受持，
Having therefore undertaken through faith the training precepts without exception as announced, 
甚至不顾其生命而善成就之。
one should completely perfect them without regard for life. For this is said: [36]

即所谓：如鸡鸡鸟护卵，
“As a hen guards her eggs,
牦牛爱尾，
Or as a yak her tail,
如人爱子，
Or like a darling child,
保护他的独眼。
Or like an only eye—
非常的谨慎与尊重，护戒也是这样的。
So you who are engaged Your virtue to protect, Be prudent at all times And ever scrupulous.” (Source untraced)

他处又说：
Also it is said further: 
“大王啊！我为声闻制定的学处，
“So too, sire, when a training precept for disciples is announced by me, 
我的声闻弟子们纵有生命之危亦不犯”。
my disciples do not transgress it even for the sake of life” (A IV 201).

在这里，当知在森林中为盗贼所捆缚的故事：
99.And the story of the elders bound by robbers in the forest should be understood in this sense.
据说在（雪山边的）摩诃跋多尼森林中，有一长老为盗贼用黑藤缚住，放倒地上，
It seems that robbers in the Mahaava.t.tanii Forest bound an elder with black creepers and made him lie down. 
那长老便倒在那里七天，
While he lay there for seven days 
增长他的毗钵舍那（观），
he augmented his insight, 
得证阿那含果，
and after reaching the fruition of non-return, 
并在那里命终，
he died there 
得生梵天。
and was reborn in the Brahmaa-world. 

另一位在铜鍱洲的长老，为盗贼用蔓草缚住，放倒地上，
Also they bound another elder in Tambapa.n.ni Island (Sri Lanka) with string creepers and made him lie down. 
恰遇林火烧来，未断蔓草时，
When a forest fire came and the creepers were not cut, 
便起毗钵舍那，
he established insight 
得证等首阿罗汉果而入涅槃。
and attained Nibbaana simultaneously with his death. 
后来长部诵者无畏长老
When the Elder Abhaya, a preacher of the Diigha Nikaaya, 
和五百比丘来到这里看见了，
passed by with five hundred bhikkhus, he saw [what had happened] 
才把他的身体荼毗（火葬）了，
and he had the elder’s body cremated 
并建塔庙供养。
and a shrine built. 
所以另一位具信的善男子说：
Therefore let other clansmen also:
宁失身命，要使别解脱清净，
Maintain the rules of conduct pure, Renouncing life if there be need,
不破世界主所制的戒律仪。
Rather than break virtue’s restraint By the World’s Saviour decreed.


（二、根律仪戒的成就）正如别解脱律仪的依于信，
100.(b) And as Paatimokkha restraint is undertaken out of faith, 
而根律仪则依于念而成就。
so restraint of the sense faculties should be undertaken with mindfulness. 
依念而成，
For that is accomplished by mindfulness, 
因为由于念的坚定，
because when the sense faculties’ functions are founded on mindfulness, 
则诸根不为贪欲等所侵袭。
there is no liability to invasion by covetousness and the rest. 

故说：
So, 
“诸比丘！宁为燃烧热烈辉焰的铁棒而触其眼根，亦不于眼所识的诸色而执取其（男女净等的）细相”，这是说善须忆念燃烧的教理，
recollecting the Fire Discourse, which begins thus, “Better, bhikkhus, the extirpation of the eye faculty by a red-hot burning blazing glowing iron spike than the apprehension of signs in the particulars of visible objects cognizable by the eye” (S IV 168), 
而善成就其根律仪戒，以不忘念去制止依于眼门等所起的（速行）识对于色等境界而执取于（男女等净）相，为贪欲所侵袭。
this [restraint] should be properly undertaken by preventing with unremitting mindfulness any apprehension, in the objective fields consisting of visible data, etc., of any signs, etc., likely to encourage covetousness, etc., to invade consciousness occurring in connection with the eye door, and so on.

然而（根律仪戒）若不如是成就，
101. [37] When not undertaken thus, 
则别解脱律仪戒亦不能长时存在，
virtue of Paatimokkha restraint is unenduring: it does not last, 
犹如没有留意筑以栅围的谷田（将为畜等所侵害）一样。
like a crop not fenced in with branches. 
又如敞开大门的村落，随时可为盗贼所袭，若无根律仪戒，则亦随时可为烦恼贼所害。
And it is raided by the robber defilements as a village with open gates is by thieves. 
亦如不善盖的屋为雨漏所侵，而他的心则为贪欲所侵入，
And lust leaks into his mind as rain does into a badly-roofed house. 
所以这样说：
For this is said:
对于色声味香触，
“Among the visible objects, sounds, and smells, And tastes, and tangibles, 
当护你的一切根。
guard the faculties; 
若对色等门开而不护，
For when these doors are open and unguarded,
譬如盗劫村落而为害。
Then thieves will come and raid as ’twere a village (?).
譬如恶盖屋，
And just as with an ill-roofed house
必为雨漏侵，
The rain comes leaking in, so too
如是不修心，
Will lust come leaking in for sure
将为贪欲侵。
Upon an undeveloped mind” (Dhp 13).

假使根律仪戒成就，
102. When it is undertaken thus, 
则别解脱律仪戒亦能长时受持，
virtue of Paatimokkha restraint is enduring: 
犹如善筑栅围的谷田一样。
it lasts, like a crop well fenced in with branches. 
又如善护大门的村落，则不为盗贼所劫，而他亦不为烦恼贼所害。
And it is not raided by the robber defilements, as a village with well-guarded gates is not by thieves. 
亦如善盖的屋，不为雨漏所侵，而他的心则不为贪欲所侵入。
And lust does not leak into his mind, as rain does not into a well-roofed house. 
所以这样说：
For this is said:
对于色声味香触，
“Among the visible objects, sounds and smells, And tastes and tangibles, 
当护你的一切根。
guard the faculties;
若对色等门闭而善护，
For when these doors are closed and truly guarded,
譬如盗贼无害于村落。
Thieves will not come and raid as ’twere a village (?).
譬如善盖屋，
“And just as with a well-roofed house
不为雨漏侵，
No rain comes leaking in, so too
如是善修心，不为贪欲侵，No lust comes leaking in for sure
Upon a well-developed mind” (Dhp 14).

这是最殊胜的教法。
103. This, however, is the teaching at its very highest.
心是这样迅速的奔驰，
This mind is called “quickly transformed” (A I 10), 
所以必须以不净作意而断已起的贪欲，使根律仪成就。
so restraint of the faculties should be undertaken by removing arisen lust with the contemplation of foulness, 
犹如新出家的婆耆舍长老一样。
as was done by the Elder Va^ngiisa soon after he had gone forth. [38]

据说新出家的婆耆舍长老，正在行乞之际，看见了一位妇人，生起贪欲之心。
As the elder was wandering for alms, it seems, soon after going forth, lust arose in him on seeing a woman. 
于是他对阿难长老说：
Thereupon he said to the venerable Aananda:
我为贪欲燃烧了，
“I am afire with sensual lust.
我的心整个地烧起来了。
And burning flames consume my mind;
瞿昙啊，哀愍我吧！
In pity tell me, Gotama,
为说良善的消灭法。
How to extinguish it for good” (S I 188).
阿难长老答道：
The elder said:
你的心烧，因为想的颠倒，
“You do perceive mistakenly, That burning flames consume your mind.
应该舍弃和贪欲相关的净相，
Look for no sign of beauty there,For that it is which leads to lust.
当于不净善定一境而修心，
See foulness there and keep your mind Harmoniously concentrated;
见诸行的无常苦无我，
Formations see as alien, As ill, not self, 
消灭你的大贪欲，
so this great lust May be extinguished, and no more
切莫再再的燃烧了！
Take fire thus ever and again” (S I 188).
（婆耆舍）长老即除去贪欲而行乞。
The elder expelled his lust and then went on with his alms round.



其次比丘应当完成其根律仪戒，
104. Moreover, a bhikkhu who is fulfilling restraint of the faculties should be 
犹如住在乔罗达格大窟的心护长老
like the Elder Cittagutta resident in the Great Cave at Kura.n.daka, 
及住在拘罗格大寺的大友长老。
and like the Elder Mahaa Mitta resident at the Great Monastery of Coraka.

据说：在乔罗达格大窟中有七佛出家的绘画，非常精美。
105.In the Great Cave of Kura.n.daka, it seems, there was a lovely painting of the Renunciation of the Seven Buddhas. 
一次，有很多比丘参观此窟，
A number of bhikkhus wandering about among the dwellings 
见了绘画说：
saw the painting and said, 
“尊者，这画很精美”。
“What a lovely painting, venerable sir!” 
长老说：
The elder said: 
“诸师！我住此窟已六十多年，尚不知有此画，
“For more than sixty years, friends, I have lived in the cave, and I did not know whether there was any painting there or not. 
今天由诸具眼者所说，才得知道”。
Now, today, I know it through those who have eyes.” 
这是说长老虽在这里住这么久，
The elder, it seems, though he had lived there for so long, 
但从未张开眼睛而望窟上。
had never raised his eyes and looked up at the cave. 
据说在大窟的入口处，
And at the door of his cave 
有一株大龙树，
there was a great ironwood tree. 
他亦一向未曾仰首上望，
And the elder had never looked up at that either. 
但每年见其花瓣落于地上，而藉知其开花而已。
He knew it was in flower when he saw its petals on the ground each year.
当时国王慕长老之德，
106. The king heard of the elder’s great virtues, 
曾三度遣使请他入宫受供养，
and he sent for him three times, desiring to pay homage to him. 
但都遭拒绝了。
When the elder did not go, 
于是国王便令王城内乳哺小儿的小妇们的乳房都捆缚起来，
he had the breasts of all the women with infants in the town bound 
加以盖印封锁。他说：
and sealed off, 
“直待长老来此，一切乳儿才得吸乳”。
[saying] “As long as the elder does not come let the children go without milk,” [39] 
长老因怜悯乳儿，遂来大村。
Out of compassion for the children the elder went to Mahaagaama. 
国王闻此消息，便对其臣子说：
When the king heard [that he had come, he said] 
“去请长老入宫，我要从他受三皈五戒”。
“Go and bring the elder in. I shall take the precepts.” 
长老入宫，
Having had him brought up into the inner palace, 
国王礼拜
he paid homage to him 
和供养之后说：
and provided him with a meal. 
“尊者！今天很忙，没有机会，
Then, saying, “Today, venerable sir, there is no opportunity. 
我将于明天受戒”。
I shall take the precepts tomorrow,” 
并取长老的钵，
he took the elder’s bowl. 
和王后共同略送一程，然后拜别。
After following him for a little, he paid homage with the queen and turned back. 
但当国王或王后礼拜时，他同样的说：“祝大王幸福”！这样过了七天，
As seven days went by thus, whether it was the king who paid homage or whether it was the queen, the elder said, “May the king be happy.”
其他的比丘问长老道：
107. Bhikkhus asked: 
“尊者，你在国王礼拜时说，祝大王幸福，为什么王后礼拜时也说同样的句子”？
“Why is it, venerable sir, that whether it is the king who pays the homage or the queen you say ‘May the king be happy’?” 
长老答道：
The elder replied: 
“我并没有分别谁是国王，谁是王后”。
“Friends, I do not notice whether it is the king or the queen.” 
过了七天，国王想道：“何必使长老住在这里受苦呢”？便让他回去。
At the end of seven days [when it was found that] the elder was not happy living there, he was dismissed by the king. 
长老回到乔罗达格大窟后，
He went back to the Great Cave at Kura.n.daka. 
夜间在经行处经行，
When it was night he went out onto his walk. 
那住在大龙树的天神执一火炬站于一边，
A deity who dwelt in the ironwood tree stood by with a torch of sticks. 
使他的业处（定境）极净而明显。
Then his meditation subject became quite clear and plain. 
长老心生喜悦，想道：“怎么我的业处今天这样异常的明显”？
The elder, [thinking] “How clear my meditation subject is today!” was glad, 
过了中夜之后，全山震动，便证阿罗汉果。
and immediately after the middle watch he reached Arahantship, making the whole rock resound.
是故欲求利益的其他善男子亦当如是：
108. So when another clansman seeks his own good:
勿奔放其眼目，
Let him not be hungry-eyed,
如森林的猕猴，
Like a monkey in the groves,
如彷徨的野鹿，
Like a wild deer in the woods,
如惊骇的幼儿。
Like a nervous little child.
放下你的两眼，
Let him go with eyes downcast
但见一寻之地：
Seeing a plough yoke’s length before,
勿作象森林的猿猴，那样不定的心的奴隶。
That he fall not in the power Of the forest-monkey mind.

大友长老的母亲，
109. The Elder Mahaa Mitta’s mother 
一次身上发生毒肿，
was sick with a poisoned tumour. 
便对她的女儿出家的比丘尼说：
She told her daughter, who as a bhikkhunii had also gone forth, 
“你去将我的病状告诉你的哥哥，
“Lady, go to your brother. Tell him my trouble 
要他拿些药来”。
and bring back some medicine.” 
她即往告其兄。
She went and told him. 
长老对她说：
The elder said: 
“我实不知如何采集药根，
“I do not know how to gather root medicines 
也不知如何制药；
and such things and concoct a medicine from them. 
然而我将告诉你一种药：
But rather I will tell you a medicine: 
便是我从出家以来，
since I went forth 
从未以贪心看异性之色而破坏我的诸根律仪。
I have not broken [my virtue of restraint of] the sense faculties by looking at the bodily form of the opposite sex with a lustful mind. 
你将我的实语告诉母亲，并祝她迅速病愈。
By this [40] declaration of truth may my mother get well. 
你现在去对母亲优婆夷这样说，同时按摩她的身体”。
Go and tell the lay devotee and rub her body.” 
她回去照样的说了此意。
She went and told her what had happened and then did as she had been instructed. 
便在那一刹那间，优婆夷的毒肿如泡沫一样地消失了，
At that very moment the lay devotee’s tumour vanished, shrinking away like a lump of froth. 
她的心中无限喜悦，流露这样的话：
She got up and uttered a cry of joy: 
“如果正等觉者在世的话，
“If the Fully Enlightened One were still alive, 
必定会用他的网纹之手触摩象我的儿子这样的比丘的头顶”。
why should he not stroke with his netadorned hand the head of a bhikkhu like my son?” 
是故：
So:
今于圣教出家的善男子，
110. Let another noble clansman Gone forth in the Dispensation
当如大友长老的住于根律仪。
Keep, as did the Elder Mitta, Perfect faculty restraint.


（三、活命遍净戒的成就）如根律仪的依于念，
111. (c) As restraint of the faculties is to be undertaken by means of mindfulness, 
而活命遍净戒当依精进而成就。
so livelihood purification is to be undertaken by means of energy. 
依精进而成，
For that is accomplished by energy, 
因为善于励力精进者，能舍邪命故。
because the abandoning of wrong livelihood is effected in one who has rightly applied energy. 
所以精进于行乞等的正求，得以断除不适合的邪求，受用于遍净的资具，
Abandoning, therefore, unbefitting wrong search, this should be undertaken with energy by means of the right kind of search consisting in going on alms round, etc., 
得以违避不遍净，如避毒蛇一样，这样便得成就活命遍净戒。
avoiding what is of impure origin as though it were a poisonous snake, and using only requisites of pure origin.

没有受持头陀支的人，
112.Herein, for one who has not taken up the ascetic practices, 
从僧伽
any requisites obtained from the Community, 
与僧集
from a group of bhikkhus, 
或从俗人由于信乐他的说法等的德而得来的资具，
or from laymen who have confidence in his special qualities of teaching the Dhamma, etc., 
则称为遍净的。
are called “of pure origin.” 
由于行乞等而得来的为极清净。
But those obtained on alms round, etc., are of extremely pure origin. 

若受持头陀支的人，
For one who has taken up the ascetic practices, 
由行乞及由于（俗人）信乐他的常行头陀之德或随顺于头陀支的定法而得来的资具，则称为遍净的。
those obtained on alms round, etc., and—as long as this is in accordance with the rules of the ascetic practices—from people who have confidence in his special qualities of asceticism, are called “of pure origin.” 
若为治病，获得了腐烂的诃黎勒果及四种甘药（酥、蜜、油、砂糖），但他这样想：“让其他同梵行者受用这四种甘药”，他于是仅食诃黎勒果片，这样的人，
And if he has got putrid urine with mixed gall nuts and “four-sweets” for the purpose of curing a certain affliction, and he eats only the broken gall nuts, thinking, “Other companions in the life of purity will eat the ‘four-sweets’,” 
是适合于受持头陀支的。
his undertaking of the ascetic practices is befitting, 
他实名为最上雅利安种族的比丘。
for he is then called a bhikkhu who is supreme in the Noble Ones’ heritages (A II 28).

其次关于衣服等资具，
113. As to the robe and the other requisites, 
对于遍净活命者，若用示相暗示及迂回之说而求衣食，是不适合的，
no hint, indication, roundabout talk, or intimation about robes and alms food is allowable for a bhikkhu who is purifying his livelihood. 
然而不持头陀行者，若为住处而用示相暗示及迂回之说，是适合的。
But a hint, indication, or roundabout talk about a resting place is allowable for one who has not taken up the ascetic practices. [41]

为住处而示相，
114. Herein, a “hint” 
例如他在准备一块土地，
is when one who is getting the preparing of the ground, etc., done for the purpose of [making] a resting place is asked, 
在家人见而问道：“尊者！做什么？谁使你这样做”？
“What is being done, venerable sir? Who is having it done?” 
答道：“谁也没有呀”！
and he replies, “No one”; 
象这样的其他形式，名为示相业。
or any other such giving of hints. 

暗示，
An “indication” 
如问优婆塞道：“你住在什么地方”？
is saying, “Lay follower, where do you live?”—
“尊者！高阁啦”。
“In a mansion, venerable sir”—
“优婆塞，比丘不能住高阁吗”？
“But, lay follower, a mansion is not allowed for bhikkhus.” 
象这样的话，为暗示业。
Or any other such giving of indication. 

若说：
“Roundabout talk” is saying, 
“这里比丘的住处实在太狭小了”，
“The resting place for the Community of Bhikkhus is crowded”; 
象此等的话为迂回之说。
or any other such oblique talk.

对于医药方面，一切示相等也是适合的。
115. All, however, is allowed in the case of medicine. 
然而取得的药品，治病痊愈之后，是否仍可服用？
But when the disease is cured, is it or is it not allowed to use the medicine obtained in this way? 
据律师说，
Herein, the Vinaya specialists say that 
这是如来许可的，
the opening has been given by the Blessed One, 
故可以用。
therefore it is allowable. 
经师说，
But the Suttanta specialists say that 
虽不犯罪，
though there is no offence, 
但扰乱活命，
nevertheless the livelihood is sullied, 
故断言不可以用。
therefore it is not allowable.

虽为世尊所允许，但他也不作示相暗示及迂回之说等的表示。
116. But one who does not use hints, indications, roundabout talk, or intimation, though these are permitted by the Blessed One, 
由于少欲之德等，纵有生命之危，亦仅受用得自示相等以外的资具，
and who depends only on the special qualities of fewness of wishes, etc., and makes use only of requisites obtained otherwise than by indication, etc., even when he thus risks his life, 
这种人称为最严肃的生活者，
is called supreme in living in effacement, 
如舍利弗长老。
like the venerable Saariputta.


据说：一次舍利弗和大目犍连长老同住在一个森林中，修远离行。
117. It seems that the venerable one was cultivating seclusion at one time, living in a certain forest with the Elder Mahaa Moggallaana. 
有一天，他忽然腹痛，非常剧烈。
One day an affliction of colic arose in him, causing him great pain. 
晚上大目犍连长老来访，
In the evening the Elder Mahaa Moggallaana went to attend upon him. 
见尊者卧病，
Seeing him lying down, 
探得病原之后，问道：
he asked what the reason was. And then he asked, 
“道友！你以前是怎样治愈的”？
“What used to make you better formerly, friend?” 
答道：
The elder said, 
“我在家时，母亲用酥蜜砂糖等混合纯粹的乳粥给我吃了便好”。
“When I was a layman, friend, my mother used to mix ghee, honey, sugar and so on, and give me rice gruel with pure milk. That used to make me better.” 
“道友！如果你或我有福的话，
Then the other said, “So be it, friend. If either you or I have merit, 
明天可能获得此粥的”。
perhaps tomorrow we shall get some.”


此时一位寄居于经行处末端的树上的天神，
118. Now, a deity who dwelt in a tree at the end of the walk 
听到了他们的谈话，想道：“明天我将使尊者获得此粥”。
over heard thei conversation. [Thinking] “I will find rice gruel for the lord tomorrow,” 
他即刻跑到长老的檀越的家里，
he went meanwhile to the family who was supporting the elder [42] 
进入他的长子身内，
and entered into the body of the eldest son, 
使其病痛，
causing him discomfort. 
对那些集合的家人说着治疗的方法（附于长子身内的天神而托他的口说的）：
Then he told the assembled relatives the price of the cure: 
“如果明天你们准备某种乳粥供养长老，
“If you prepare rice gruel of such a kind tomorrow for the elder, 
我将离去你的长子之身”。
I will set this one free.” 
他们说：“纵使你不说，
They said: “Even without being told by you 
我们也是常常供养长老的”。
we regularly supply the elder’s needs,” 
第二天，他们已准备好粥，
and on the following day they prepared rice gruel of the kind needed.
大目犍连长老早晨去对舍利弗长老说：
119.The Elder Mahaa Moggallaana came in the morning and said, “
“道友！你在这里等着，直至我去乞食回来”。
Stay here, friend, till I come back from the alms round.” 
当他进入村落时，
Then he went into the village. 
那家人看到了，
Those people met him. 
即刻向前接过长老的钵，
They took his bowl, 
盛满如前所说的乳粥供养他。
filled it with the stipulated kind of rice gruel, and gave it back to him. 
长老即表示要走了。
The elder made as though to go, 
可是他们要求长老在那里吃了，
but they said, “Eat, venerable sir, we shall give you more.” 
然后再装满一钵给他带回去供养舍利弗长老。
When the elder had eaten, they gave him another bowlful. 
他回来后，
The elder left. 
把粥授给舍利弗说：“道友！请吃粥吧”。
Bringing the alms food to the venerable Saariputta, he said, “Here, friend Saariputta, eat.” 
长老看了说：
When the elder saw it, he thought, 
“很如意的粥，但不知你怎样获得的”？
“The gruel is very nice. How was it got?” 
经他思惟之后而知此粥的来由说：
and seeing how it had been obtained, he said, 
“道友目犍连，拿去吧，我不应受用此粥”。
“Friend, the alms food cannot be used.”
目犍连长老并没有想“他竟不吃象我这样的人替他拿来的粥”，
120. Instead of thinking, “He does not eat alms food brought by the likes of me,” 
听了他的话，即刻拿着钵的边缘把粥倒在一边。
the other at once took the bowl by the rim and turned it over on one side. 
当粥倒在地上时，
As the rice gruel fell on the ground 
长老的病也好了。
the elder’s affliction vanished. 
以后四十五年间，亦未再生此病。
From then on it did not appear again during forty-five years.
于是他对目犍连说：
121.Then he said to the venerable Mahaa Moggallaana, 
“道友！纵使把我的脏腑痛出肚子来在地上跳动，
“Friend, even if one’s bowels come out and trail on the ground, 
也不应该吃那种由于我的语言所表示而得来的粥”。
it is not fitting to eat gruel got by verbal intimation,” 
并喜说此颂：
and he uttered this exclamation:
我若吃了由我的语言表示所得的蜜粥，便是污蔑了我的活命戒，
My livelihood might well be blamed If I were to consent to eat The honey and the gruel obtained By influence of verbal hints.
纵使我的脏腑迸出于肚外，
And even if my bowels obtrude And trail outside, 
宁舍身命也不破活命戒。
and even though My life is to be jeopardized, I will not blot my livelihood (Mil 370).
除邪求，我的心多么自在，
For I will satisfy my heart By shunning all wrong kinds of search;
我决不作为佛呵弃的邪求。
And never will I undertake The search the Buddhas have condemned. [43]

食芒果（庵罗果）的鸡跋罗准跋住者大帝须长老的故事，亦可在这里说。
122 And here too should be told the story of the Elder Mahaa Tissa the Mango-eater who lived at Ciiragumba (see §132 below). 
总而言之：
So in all respects:
由信出家的聪慧的行者，
A man who has gone forth in faith
莫起邪求之心保持活命的清净。
Should purify his livelihood And, seeing clearly, give no thought To any search that is not good.


（四、资具依止戒的成就）如活命遍净戒由精进而成就，
123. (d) And as livelihood purification is to be undertaken by means of energy, 
资具依止戒当依智慧而成就。
so virtue dependent on requisites is to be undertaken by means of understanding. 
因为有慧者能见资具的过失与功德，故说由慧成就。
For that is accomplished by understanding, because one who possesses understanding is able to see the advantages and the dangers in requisites. 
是故舍离资具的贪求，依正当的方法而获得的资具，唯有以慧如法观察而受用，方得成就此戒。
So one should abandon greed for requisites and undertake that virtue by using requisites obtained lawfully and properly, after reviewing them with understanding in the way aforesaid.

这里有获得资具时及受用时的两种观察，
124. Herein, reviewing is of two kinds: at the time of receiving requisites and at the time of using them. 
当收受衣服等的时候，依界（差别想）或依厌（想）的观察，然后用之则无过。
For use (paribhoga) is blameless in one who at the time of receiving robes, etc., reviews them either as [mere] elements or as repulsive, and puts them aside for later use, 
在受用时亦然。
and in one who reviews them thus at the time of using them.

于受用中合论有四种用法：
125. Here is an explanation to settle the matter. There are four kinds of use: 
即盗受用，
use as theft, 
借受用，
use as a debt, 
嗣受用
use as an inheritance, 
及主受用。
use as a master. 

（１）若破戒之人居然于僧众中坐而受用者，名为“盗受用”。
Herein, use by one who is unvirtuous and makes use [of requisites], even sitting in the midst of the Community, is called “use as theft.” 

（２）具戒者若不观察而受用，则名“借受用”。
Use without reviewing by one who is virtuous is “use as a debt”; 
是故每次受用衣服时须作观察，
therefore the robe should be reviewed every time it is used, 
每食一口饭时亦得观察。
and the alms food lump by lump. 
如在受用时未及观察，
One who cannot do this [should review it] 
则于食前（午前）、
before the meal, 
食后（午后）、
after the meal, 
初夜、
in the first watch, 
中夜、
in the middle watch, 
后夜当作之。
and in the last watch. 
如至黎明尚无观察，
If dawn breaks on him without his having reviewed it, 
便犯于借受用。
he finds himself in the position of one who has used it as a debt. 
在每次受用床座时亦当观察。
Also the resting place should be reviewed each time it is used. 
在受用医药时，则具足念缘即可。
Recourse to mindfulness both in the accepting and the use of medicine is proper; 
纵使于领取时业已作念，若于受用时不作念，亦属于违犯。
but while this is so, though there is an offence for one who uses it without mindfulness after mindful acceptance, 
然于领取时虽未作念，若于受用时作念则不犯。
there is no offence for one who is mindful in using after accepting without mindfulness.

有四种清净法：
126. Purification is of four kinds: 
即说示净、
purification by the Teaching, 
律仪净、
purification by restraint, 
遍求净
purification by search, 
及观察净。
and purification by reviewing. 

此中：说示净为别解脱律仪戒，
Herein, virtue of the Paatimokkha restraint is called “purification by the Teaching”; [44] 
因为由（佛的）说示而清净，故名说示净。
for that is so called because it purifies by means of teaching. 

律仪净为根律仪戒，
Virtue of restraint of faculties is called “purification by restraint”; 
因为由于“我不再如是作”的决心而律仪清净，故名律仪净。
for that is so called because it purifies by means of the restraint in the mental resolution, “I shall not do so again.” 

遍求净为活命遍净戒，
Virtue of livelihood purification is called “purification by search”; 
彼以正当的方法而获得资具，能舍于邪求而遍求清净，故名遍求净。
for that is so called because search is purified in one who abandons wrong search and gets requisites lawfully and properly. 

观察净为资具依止戒，
Virtue dependent on requisites is called “purification by reviewing”; 
因为以前述之法观察而得清净，故名观察净。
for that is so called because it purifies by the reviewing of the kind already described. 

如果他们在收受时未作念，
Hence it was said above (§125): “There is no offence for one who is mindful in using after accepting without mindfulness.”
而在应用时作念，亦为不犯。

（３）七有学的资具受用，
127. Use of the requisites by the seven kinds of trainers 
为“嗣受用”。
is called “use as an inheritance”; 
因为他们是世尊的儿子，
for they are the Buddha’s sons, 
所以是父亲所属的资具的嗣受者而用其资具。
therefore they make use of the requisites as the heirs of requisites belonging to their father. 
然而他们毕竟是受用世尊的资具，
But how then, is it the Blessed One’s requisites 
还是受用在家信众的资具呢？
or the laity’s requisites that are used? 
虽为信施之物，
Although given by the laity, 
但由世尊所听许，所以是世尊的所有物。
they actually belong to the Blessed One, because it is by the Blessed One that they are permitted. 
故知为受用世尊的资具。
That is why it should be understood that the Blessed One’s requisites are used. 
这里可以《法嗣经》为例证。
The confirmation here is in the Dhammadaayaada Sutta (MN 3).

（４）漏尽者的受用为“主受用”，
Use by those whose cankers are destroyed is called “use as a master”; 
因为他们业已超越爱的奴役成为主而受用。
for they make use of them as masters because they have escaped the slavery of craving.



在此等受用中，
128. As regards these kinds of use, 
主受用
use as a master 
与嗣受用
and use as an inheritance 
则适宜于一切（凡圣）。
are allowable for all. 
借受用则不适合。
Use as a debt is not allowable, 
盗受用更不必说了。
to say nothing of use as theft. 
然而具戒者的观察受用，
But this use of what is reviewed by one who is virtuous 
因对治借受用故成为非借受用，
is use freed from debt because it is the opposite of use as a debt 
属于嗣受用。
or is included in use as an inheritance too. F
以具戒者具备诸戒学，
or one possessed of virtue 
故得名为有学者。
is called a trainer too because of possessing this training.
在这些受用中以主受用为最上。
129. As regards these three kinds of use, since use as a master is best, 
是故希求于主受用的比丘，当依上述的观察方法而观察受用，以成就于资具依止戒。如是作者为作其所应作者。
when a bhikkhu undertakes virtue dependent on requisites, he should aspire to that and use them after reviewing them in the way described. 


故如是说：
And this is said: [45]
胜慧声闻已闻善逝所说法，
“The truly wise disciple Who listens to the DhammaAs taught by the Sublime One
对于团食精舍与床座，除去僧伽黎衣的尘垢的水，必须深深的观察而受用。
Makes use, after reviewing, Of alms food, and of dwelling, And of a resting place, And also of the water For washing dirt from robes” (Sn 391).
是故对于团食精舍与床座，除去僧伽黎衣的尘垢的水，比丘切勿染著此等法，犹如露珠不著于荷叶。
“So like a drop of water Lying on leaves of lotus, A bhikkhu is unsullied By any of these matters, By alms food, [and by dwelling,] And by a resting place, And also by the water For washing dirt from robes” (Sn 392).
由他之助而得布施的时候，对于硬食软食及诸味，应常观察而知量，犹如涂药治疮伤。
“Since aid it is and timely Procured from another The right amount he reckons, Mindful without remitting In chewing and in eating, In tasting food besides: He treats it as an ointment
Applied upon a wound.” (Source untraced)
如渡沙漠食子肉。亦如注油于车轴。但为维持于生命，如是取食莫染着。
“So like the child’s flesh in the desert Like the greasing for the axle, He should eat without delusion Nutriment to keep alive.” (Source untraced)

为成就资具依止戒的（僧护长老的）外甥僧护沙弥的故事，亦当在这里叙述，
130. And in connection with the fulfilling of this virtue dependent on requisites there should be told the story of the novice Sa^ngharakkhita the Nephew. 
他以正当的观察而受用是这样的：
For he made use of requisites after reviewing, according as it is said:
我食沙利冷米粥，
“Seeing me eat a dish of rice Quite cold, 
和尚对我说：
my preceptor observed:
“沙弥，勿无制限烧你的舌头”！
‘Novice, if you are not restrained, Be careful not to burn your tongue.’
我闻和尚之语心寒栗，
On hearing my Preceptor’s words, I then and there felt urged to act And, 
即于座上证得阿罗汉。
sitting in a single session, I reached the goal of Arahantship.
我的思惟圆满犹如十五的夜月、
Since I am now waxed full in thought Like the full moon of the fifteenth (M III 277),
诸漏已尽，自此更无后有了。
And all my cankers are destroyed, There is no more becoming now.” [46]
是故那些欲求苦的灭尽者，
And so should any other man Aspiring to end suffering
亦应如理观察受用一切的资具。
Make use of all the requisites Wisely after reviewing them.

这是别解脱律仪戒等四种。上面为杂论四遍净戒。
So virtue is of four kinds as “virtue of Paatimokkha restraint,” and so on.


（五）（五法）于五种分中：
131. 18. In the first pentad in the fivefold section 
（１．制限遍净，无制限遍净，圆满遍净，无执取遍净，安息遍净）第一须知未具足戒等五种义；
the meaning should be understood in accordance with the virtue of those not fully admitted to the Order, and so on. 
即如《无碍解道》中说：
For this is said in the Pa.tisambhidaa: 
“（１）什么是制限遍净戒？
“(a) What is virtue consisting in limited purification? 
未具足者受持有制限的学处，
That of the training precepts for those not fully admitted to the Order: 
为制限遍净戒。
such is virtue consisting in limited purification. 
（２）什么是无制限遍净戒？
(b) What is virtue consisting in unlimited purification? 
已具足者受持无制限的学处，
That of the training precepts for those fully admitted to the Order: 
为无制限遍净戒。
such is virtue consisting in unlimited purification. 
（３）什么是圆满遍净戒？
(c) What is virtue consisting in fulfilled purification? 
与善法相应的善良凡夫，
That of magnanimous ordinary men devoted to profitable things, 
有学以前的（三学）圆具者，
who are perfecting [the course] that ends in trainership, 
不顾身命及舍身命而受持学处者（的受持学处），
regardless of the physical body and life, having given up [attachment to] life: 
为圆满遍净戒。
such is virtue of fulfilled purification, 
（４）什么是无执取遍净戒？
(d) What is virtue consisting in purification not adhered to? 
七有学（的学处），
That of the seven kinds of trainer: 
为无执取遍净戒，
such is virtue consisting in purification not adhered to. 
（５）什么是安息遍净戒？
(e) What is virtue consisting in tranquillized purification? 
如来的声闻弟子漏尽者，
That of the Perfect One’s disciples with cankers destroyed, 
缘觉、
of the Paccekabuddhas, 
如来、
of the Perfect Ones, 
阿罗汉、
accomplished 
等正觉者的学处，
and fully enlightened: 
为安息遍净戒”。
such is virtue consisting in tranquillized purification” (Pa.tis I 42–43).


（１）此中，未具足戒，因在数目上有限制，故为“制限遍净戒”。
132. (a) Herein, the virtue of those not fully admitted to the Order should be understood as virtue consisting in limited purification, because it is limited by the number [of training precepts, that is, five or eight or ten].


（２）已具足者的戒：
(b) That of those fully admitted to the Order is [describable] thus:
九千俱胝又一百八十俱胝，
Nine thousand millions, and a hundred And eighty millions then as well,
五百万又三万六千。
And fifty plus a hundred thousand, And thirty-six again to swell. The total restraint disciplines:
正觉者说此等的防护戒，
These rules the Enlightened One explains Told under heads for filling out, Which the Discipline restraint contains.
于律藏中依然是以略门显示戒学的。依此数目，虽仍有限制，但以无限而受持，
So although limited in number, [47] it should yet be understood as virtue consisting in unlimited purification, 
亦不为利养
since it is undertaken without reserve and has no obvious limit such as gain, 
名誉
fame, 
亲属
relatives, 
肢体
limbs 
生命的条件所限制，所以说“无制限遍净戒”。
or life. 

犹如食芒果的鸡跋罗准跋住者大帝须长老的戒。
Like the virtue of the Elder Mahaa Tissa the Mango-eater who lived at Ciiragumba (see §122 above).


那长老说：因爱肢体舍于财，为护生命舍于肢；
“Wealth for a sound limb’s sake should be renounced, And one who guards his life gives up his limbs;
依法而作思惟者，当舍一切财命肢。
And wealth and limbs and life, each one of these, A man gives up who practices the Dhamma.”
这位善人如是随念不舍，
133. For that venerable one never abandoned the following good man’s recollection:
甚至有生命之危的时候亦不犯学处，
And he never transgressed a training precept even when his life was in the balance, 
依这种无制限的遍净戒，他在优婆塞的背上，便得阿罗汉果。
and in this way he reached Arahantship with that same virtue of unlimited purification as his support while he was being carried on a lay devotee’s back. 
所谓：
According to as it is said:
“不是你的父母与亲友，
“Nor your mother nor your father Nor your relatives and kin
因你具戒故他这样做”，
Have done as much as this for you Because you are possessed of virtue.”
我生寒栗而作如理的正观，
So, stirred with urgency, and wisely Comprehending36 with insight,
便在他的背上证得阿罗汉。
While carried on his helper’s back He reached the goal of Arahantship.


（３）善人之戒，
134. (c) The magnanimous ordinary man’s virtue, 
自从圆具以后，
which from the time of admission to the Order 
即如善净的明珠及善加锻炼了的黄金一样而极清净，连一心的尘垢也没有生起，
is devoid even of the stain of a [wrong] thought because of its extreme purity, like a gem of purest water, like well-refined gold, 
实为得证阿罗汉的近因，
becomes the proximate cause for Arahantship itself, 
故名“圆满遍净戒”，
which is why it is called consisting of fulfilled purification; 
犹如大僧护长老和他的外甥僧护长老的戒一样。
like that of the lders Saṅgharakkhita the Great and Saṅgharakkhita the Nephew.

据说：大僧护长老，
135. The Elder Sa^ngharakkhita the Great (Mahaa Sa^ngharakkhita), 
年逾六十（法腊），
aged over sixty, 
卧于临死的床上，
was lying, it seems, on his deathbed. 
比丘众问他证得出世间法没有？
The Order of Bhikkhus questioned him about attainment of the supramundane state. 
他说：“我没有证得出世间法”。
The elder said: “I have no supramundane state.” 
于是他的一位少年比丘侍者说：
Then the young bhikkhu who was attending on him said: 
“尊者！四方十二由旬之内的人，为了你的涅槃，都来集合于此，
“Venerable sir, people have come as much as twelve leagues, thinking that you have reached Nibbaana. 
如果你也和普通的凡夫一样命终，则未免要使信众失悔的”。
It will be a disappointment for many if you die as an ordinary man.”— 
“道友！我因欲于未来得见弥勒世尊，
“Friend, thinking to see the Blessed One Metteyya, 
所以未作毗钵舍那（观），
I did not try for insight. [48] 
然而众望如是，请助我坐起，给我以作观的机会”。
So help me to sit up and give me the chance.” 
长老坐定之后，侍者便出房去。
He helped the elder to sit up and went out. 
当在他刚出来的刹那，长老便证阿罗汉果，
As he went out the elder reached Arahantship 
并以弹指通知他。
and he gave a sign by snapping his fingers. 
僧众即集合而对他说：
The Order assembled and said to him: 
“尊者！在此临终之时得证出世间法，实为难作已作”。
“Venerable sir, you have done a difficult thing in achieving the supramundane state in the hour of death.”—
“诸道友！这不算难作之事，
“That was not difficult, friends. 
我将告诉你真实难作的：
But rather I will tell you what is difficult. Friends, 
我自出家以来，未曾作无念无智之业”。
I see no action done [by me] without mindfulness and unknowingly since the time I went forth.” 

他的外甥（僧护），在五十岁（法腊）的时候，亦曾以类似之事而证阿罗汉果。
His nephew also reached Arahantship in the same way at the age of fifty years.
若人既少闻，诸戒不正持，
136. “Now, if a man has little learning And he is careless of his virtue,
闻戒两俱无，因此被人呵。
They censure him on both accounts For lack of virtue and of learning.
若人虽少闻，诸戒善正持，
“But if he is of little learning Yet he is careful of his virtue,
因戒为人赞，闻则未成就。
They praise him for his virtue, so It is as though he too had learning.
若人有多闻，诸戒不正持，
“And if he is of ample learning Yet he is careless of his virtue,
缺戒为人呵，闻亦无成就。
They blame him for his virtue, so It is as though he had no learning.
若人有多闻，诸戒善正持，
“But if he is of ample learning And he is careful of his virtue,
戒与闻双修，因此为人赞。
They give him praise on both accounts For virtue and as well for learning.
多闻持法者，有慧佛弟子，
“The Buddha’s pupil of much learning Who keeps the Law with understanding—
品如阎浮金，谁得诽辱之？
A jewel of Jambu River gold Who is here fit to censure him?
彼为婆罗门，诸天所称赞。
Deities praise him [constantly], By Brahmaa also is he praised (A II 7).


（４）有学的戒不执著于恶见，或凡夫的不著有贪之戒，故名“无执取遍净戒”。
137. (d) What should be understood as virtue consisting in purification not adhered to  is trainers’ virtue, because it is  not adhered to by [false] view, and ordinary men’s virtue when not adhered to by greed. 

如富家之子帝须长老的戒一样。
Like the virtue of the Elder Tissa the Landowner’s Son (Ku.tumbiyaputta-Tissa-thera). 
长老即依如是之戒而证得阿罗汉的，
Wanting to become established in Arahantship in dependence on such virtue, 

他对怨敌说：
this venerable one told his enemies:
“我今告知汝，断我一双足，
I broke the bones of both my legs To give the pledge you asked from me.
若有贪之死，我实惭且恶”。
I am revolted and ashamed At death accompanied by greed. [49]
我如是思惟，如理而正观，
“And after I had thought on this, And wisely then applied insight,
至于黎明时，得证阿罗汉。
When the sun rose and shone on me, I had become an Arahant” (M-a I 233).

有一位重病而不能用自己的手吃饭的长老，
138. Also there was a certain senior elder who was very ill and unable to eat with his own hand. 
卧于自己的粪尿中。
He was writhing smeared with his own urine and excrement. 
一位青年见了叹气说；
Seeing him, a certain young bhikkhu said, 
“啊！多么命苦呀”！
“Oh, what a painful process life is!” 
大长老对他说：
The senior elder told him: 
“朋友！我若死于今时，无疑的，可享天福。
“If I were to die now, friend, I should obtain the bliss of heaven; I have no doubt of that. 
然而坏了戒而得天福，实无异于舍了比丘学处而得俗家的生活，
But the bliss obtained by breaking this virtue would be like the lay state obtained by disavowing the training,” 
所以我愿与戒共死”。
and he added: “I shall die together with my virtue.” 
他在卧于原处对他的病而作正观，
As he lay there, he comprehended that same illness [with insight], 
获得阿罗汉果，
and he reached Arahantship. 
对比丘众而说此偈：
Having done so, he pronounced these verses to the Order of Bhikkhus:
我患于重疾，为病所苦恼，
“I am victim of a sickening disease That racks me with its burden of cruel pain;
此身速萎悴，如花置热土。
As flowers in the dust burnt by the sun, So this my corpse will soon have withered up.
非美以为美，不净思为净。
“Unbeautiful called beautiful, Unclean while reckoned as if clean,
满身污秽物，不见谓色净。
Though full of ordure seeming fair To him that cannot see it clear.
臭恶不净身，病摧痛可厌。
“So out upon this ailing rotting body, Fetid and filthy, punished with affliction,
放逸昏迷者，善趣道自弃。
Doting on which this silly generation Has lost the way to be reborn in heaven!” (J-a II 437)


（５）阿罗汉等的戒，因一切的热恼安息清净，故名“安息遍净戒”。
139. (e) It is the virtue of the Arahants, etc., that should be understood as tranquillized purification, because of tranquillization of all disturbance and because of purifiedness.


以上为制限遍净等五种。
So it is of five kinds as “consisting in limited purification,” and so on.

这里的“舍断”，除了上述的杀生等的不发生之外，更无他法可说。
141.And here there is no state called abandoning other than the mere non-arising of the killing of living things, etc., as stated. 
杀生等的舍断而住于善法，为确持之义，
But the abandoning of a given [unprofitable state] upholds [51] a given profitable state in the sense of providing a foundation for it, 
又不使其动摇，为正持义，
and concentrates it by preventing wavering, 
此实合于前面所说的确持正持的戒行之义，故名为戒。
so it is called “virtue” (siila) in the sense of composing (siilana), reckoned as upholding and concentrating as stated earlier (§19).
关于其他的四法，
即杀生等的“离”，
彼等的“律仪”，
与此（离及律仪）两者相应的“思”及不犯杀生等的“不犯”，都是依心的转起自性而说的。
The other four things mentioned refer to the presence of occurrence of will as abstention from such and such, as restraint of such and such, as the volition associated with both of these, and as non-transgression in one who does not transgress such and such. 
彼等的戒的意义已如前说。
But their meaning of virtue has been explained already.
这便是舍断戒等的五种。
So it is of five kinds as “virtue consisting in abandoning” and so on.

以上对于什么是戒，
142. At this point the answers to the questions, “What is virtue? 
什么是戒的语义，
In what sense is it virtue?

什么是戒的功德
What are the benefits of virtue? 
及戒有几种等的问题，业已解答完毕。
How many kinds of virtue are there?” are complete.


## 六、什么是戒的杂染
143. However, it was also asked (vi) WHAT IS THE DEFILING OF IT? 
## 七、什么是戒的净化
and WHAT IS THE CLEANSING OF IT?

其次当说“什么是戒的杂染？什么是戒的净化”？毁坏等性为杂染，不毁坏等性为净化。
We answer that virtue’s tornness, etc., is its defiling, and that its untornness, etc., is its cleansing. 

（杂染）于毁坏等性，包摄（一）为利养名誉等因而破戒
Now, that tornness, etc., are comprised under the breach that has gain, fame, etc., as its cause, 
及（二）与七种淫相应者。
and under the seven bonds of sexuality. 

（一）若于七罪聚之首或末而破坏学处者，
When a man has broken the training course at the beginning or at the end in any instance of the seven classes of offences,
如割断衣襟一样，他的戒名为“毁坏”。
his virtue is called torn, like a cloth that is cut at the edge. 
若破其中部学处，
But when he has broken it in the middle, 
如衣断中部，名“切断”戒。
it is called rent, like a cloth that is rent in the middle. 
若次第而破二三学处的，
When he has broken it twice or thrice in succession, 
如于背部或腹部生起了黑红等各异颜色的某种有体色的牛一样，名“斑点”戒。
it is called blotched, like a cow whose body is some such colour as black or red with a discrepant colour appearing on the back or the belly. 
若于这里那里间杂而破学处的，
When he has broken it [all over] at intervals, 
如于体上这里那里带有各异的点点滴滴的彩色的牛一样，名“杂色”戒。
it is called mottled, like a cow speckled [all over] with discrepant-coloured spots at intervals. 
这是先说因利养等而破的毁坏等性。
This in the first place, is how there comes to be tornness with the breach that has gain, etc., as its cause.

（二）次说与七种淫相应的。
144.And likewise with the seven bonds of sexuality; 
即如世尊说：
for this is said by the Blessed One: 
“（１）婆罗门！
“Here, brahman, 
若有沙门
some ascetic 
或婆罗门
or brahman 
自誓为正梵行者，
claims to lead the life of purity rightly; 
实未与妇人交接，
for he does not [52] enter into actual sexual intercourse with women. 
然而允许妇人为之
Yet he agrees 
涂油、
to massage, 
擦身、
manipulation, 
沐浴、
bathing 
按摩、
and rubbing down by women. 
心生爱乐希求而至满足。
He enjoys it, desires it and takes satisfaction in it. 
婆罗门！此亦为梵行之毁坏、切断、斑点与杂色。
This is what is torn, rent, blotched and mottled in one who leads the life of purity. 
婆罗门，是名行不净梵行，
与淫相应故，
This man is said to lead a life of purity that is unclean. As one who is bound by the bond of sexuality, 
我说不能解脱生老死……不能解脱苦。
he will not be released from birth, ageing and death … he will not be released from suffering, I say.

（２）复次婆罗门！若有沙门或婆罗门自誓为正梵行者、实未与妇人交接，亦不许妇人为之涂油……
145. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things], 
然而与妇人嬉笑游戏，心生爱乐……我说不能解脱苦。
yet he jokes, plays and amuses himself with women …

（３）复次婆罗门！若有沙门……实未与妇人交接，不许妇人为之涂油……亦不与妇人嬉笑游戏，
146. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things], 
然而以自己之目眺望妇人之目，心生爱乐……我说不能解脱苦。
yet he gazes and stares at women eye to eye …

（４）复次婆罗门！若有沙门……实未与妇人交接……亦不以目相眺，
147. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things], 
然闻隔壁妇人之笑语歌泣之声，心生爱乐……我说不能解脱苦，
yet he listens to the sound of women through a wall or through a fence as they laugh or talk or sing or weep …

（５）复次婆罗门！若有沙门……实未与妇人交接……不以目相眺，亦不喜闻其……泣声，
148. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things], 
然而追忆过去曾与妇人相笑相语游玩时，心生爱乐……我说不能解脱苦。
yet he recalls laughs and talks and games that he formerly had with women …

（６）复次婆罗门！若有沙门……实未与妇人交接……亦不追忆过去曾与妇人相笑相语游玩，
149. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things], [53] 
然而彼见长者或长者子具备享受于五种欲时，心生爱乐……我说不能解脱苦。
yet he sees a householder or a householder’s son possessed of, endowed with, and indulging in, the five cords of sense desire …

（７）复次婆罗门！若有沙门……实未与妇人交接…亦不喜见长者或长者子……之享受，
150. “Furthermore, brahman, while he does not agree to [these things], 
然而愿成天众而修梵行，
yet he leads the life of purity aspiring to some order of deities, 
谓‘我以此戒或头陀苦行及梵行
[thinking] ‘Through this rite (virtue) or this ritual (vow) or this asceticism 
将成天人’，
I shall become a [great] deity or some [lesser] deity.’ 
于是心生喜乐希求而至满足。
He enjoys it, desires it, and takes satisfaction in it. 
婆罗门！此亦为梵行之毁坏、切断、斑点与杂色”。
This, brahman, is what is torn, rent, blotched and mottled in one who leads the life of purity. This man … will not be released from suffering, I say” (A IV 54–56).

这便是毁坏等性所摄的
This is how tornness, etc., should be understood as included under 
为利养等因而破的及与七种淫相应的。
the breachthat has gain, etc., as its cause and under the seven bonds of sexuality.

（净化）其次不毁坏等性，包摄于
151.Untornness, however, is accomplished 
（１）不毁坏一切学处，
by the complete non-breaking of the training precepts, 
（２）对于已破而可以忏悔的戒则忏悔之，
by making amends for those broken for which amends should be made, 
（３）不与七种淫相应的，
by the absence of the seven bonds of sexuality, and, as well, 
（４）忿、
by the non-arising of such evil things as anger, 
恨、
enmity, 
覆、
contempt, 
恼、
domineering, 
嫉、
envy, 
悭、
avarice, 
谄、
deceit, 
诳、
fraud, 
强情、
obduracy, 
激情、
presumption, 
慢、
pride (conceit), 
过慢、
haughtiness, 
骄、
conceit (vanity), 
放逸等恶法的不生，
and negligence (MN 7), 
（５）少欲知足减损烦恼等德的生起，
and by the arising of such qualities as fewness of wishes, contentment, and effacement (MN 24).
而且不为利养等因而破戒，
152. Virtues not broken for the purpose of gain, etc., 
或因放逸而破者已得忏悔，
and rectified by making amends after being broken by the faults of negligence, etc., 
或者不为七种淫相应
and not damaged by the bonds of sexuality 
及忿恨等恶法所害者，
and by such evil things as anger and enmity, 
都名不毁坏、不切断、不斑点、不杂色。
are called entirely untorn, unrent, unblotched, and unmottled. 
因彼等（戒）能得无束缚的状态故称自由，
And those same virtues are liberating since they bring about the state of a freeman, 
为识者所赞叹故称识者所赞，
and praised by the wise since it is by the wise that they are praised, 
以不执取于爱见故称不执取，
and unadhered-to since they are not adhered to by means of craving and views, 
能助成近行定或安止定故称定的助成者。
and conducive to concentration since they conduce to access concentration or to absorption concentration. 
是故不毁坏等性为诸戒的净化。
That is why their untornness, etc., should be understood as “cleansing” (see also VII.101f.).

其次当以二种行相成就净化：
153.This cleansing comes about in two ways: 
（１）见破戒的过患，
through seeing the danger of failure in virtue, 
（２）见具戒的功德。
and through seeing the benefit of perfected virtue. [54] 


（一、破戒的过患）此中：“诸比丘！恶戒者的破戒，有此等五种过患”，当知这是依于经而显示破戒的过患的。
Herein, the danger of failure in virtue can be seen in accordance with such suttas as that beginning, “Bhikkhus, there are these five dangers for the unvirtuous in the failure of virtue” (A III 252).
恶戒者，因恶戒不为天人所喜悦，
154. Furthermore, on account of his unvirtuousness an unvirtuous person is displeasing to deities and human beings, 
不受同梵行者所教导，
is uninstructable by his fellows in the life of purity, 
闻恶戒者被呵责时而苦感，
suffers when unvirtuousness is censured, 
闻具戒者被赞叹时而失悔，
and is remorseful when the virtuous are praised. 
同时破戒者亦如穿粗麻衣一样的丑恶。
Owing to that unvirtuousness he is as ugly as hemp cloth. 
若人随于恶戒者的意见而行，他必长时受诸恶趣之苦。
Contact with him is painful because those who fall in with his views are brought to long-lasting suffering in the states of loss. 
恶戒者虽受所施之物，然对于施者实少有价值而得大善果。
He is worthless because he causes no great fruit [to accrue] to those who give him gifts. 
他如多年的粪坑难使清净，
He is as hard to purify as a cesspit many years old. 
亦如火葬的火把同为僧俗所弃。
He is like a log from a pyre (see It 99); for he is outside both [recluseship and the lay state]. 
虽名为比丘实非比丘，
Though claiming the bhikkhu state he is no bhikkhu, 
如驴随于牛群而行。
so he is like a donkey following a herd of cattle. 
如大众之敌常受恐怖。
He is always nervous, like a man who is everyone’s enemy. 
如死尸实无共住的价值。
He is as unfit to live with as a dead carcase. 
虽有多闻之德，
Though he may have the qualities of learning, etc., 
但亦不受同梵行者所敬，
he is as unfit for the homage of his fellows in the life of purity 
如婆罗门不敬墓火一样。
as a charnel-ground fire is for that of brahmans. 
不能证得胜位，
He is as incapable of reaching the distinction of attainment 
如盲者不能见色。
as a blind man is of seeing a visible object. 
亦无望于正法，
He is as careless of the Good Law 
如旃陀罗的童子无望于王位。
as a guttersnipe is of a kingdom. 
他虽思惟是乐，
Though he fancies he is happy, 
其实是苦，
yet he suffers 
如《火聚喻》中所说的受苦者一样。
because he reaps suffering as told in the Discourse on the Mass of Fire (A IV 128–34).



即是说因为恶戒者的心染着于五欲的受用
155. Now, the Blessed One has shown that when the unvirtuous have their minds captured by pleasure and satisfaction in the indulgence of the five cords of sense desires, 
及受礼拜恭敬等的乐味，
in [receiving] salutation, in being honoured, etc., the result of that kamma, directly visible in all ways, 
甚至仅仅追忆其过去亦能使心生热恼而受口吐热血的剧苦的程度，
is very violent pain, with that [kamma] as its condition, capable of producing a gush of hot blood by causing agony of heart with the mere recollection of it.  if he sat down or lay down embracing that great mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing.


所以能见一切行相业报的世尊说（火聚喻）：
Here is the text:
“‘诸比丘！你们看见那堆燃烧光辉的大火聚吗’？
“Bhikkhus, do you see that great mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing?— 
‘看见的，世尊’。
Yes, venerable sir.—
‘诸比丘！如果抱着那堆燃烧光辉的大火聚而坐或卧，
What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one [gone forth] should sit down or lie down embracing that mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing, 
或者抱着手足柔软的刹帝利少女或婆罗门少女及长者的少女而坐或卧，你们觉得那一种较好’？
or that he should sit down or lie down embracing a warrior-noble maiden or a brahman maiden or a maiden of householder family, with soft, delicate hands and feet?—
‘世尊！当然是抱着刹帝利的少女……而坐或卧较好，抱着……大火聚而卧是多么苦痛啊’！
It would be better, venerable sir, that he should sit down or lie down embracing a warrior-noble maiden … [55] It would be painful, venerable sir,
‘诸比丘！我今告知你们，
156. “I say to you, bhikkhus, I declare to you, bhikkhus, 
如果一位
that it would be better for one [gone forth] 
恶戒的，
who is unvirtuous, 
恶法的，
who is evil-natured, 
不净
of unclean 
而有疑惑行为的，
and suspect habits, 
有隐蔽之业的，
secretive of his acts, 
非沙门而装沙门的，
who is not an ascetic and claims to be one, 
非梵行者而装梵行的，
who does not lead the life of purity and claims to do so, 
内心腐败
who is rotten within, 
流落诸漏
lecherous, 
生诸垢秽的，
and full of corruption, 
他实抱着……大火聚而坐或卧比较好。
to sit down or lie down embracing that great mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing. 
何以故？
Why is that? 
诸比丘！他虽然因抱大火聚之缘而死去，
By his doing so, bhikkhus, he might come to death 
或受等于死的苦痛，
or deadly suffering, 
然而他身坏后，不会堕落苦处恶趣恶界与地狱。
yet he would not on that account, on the breakup of the body, after death, reappear in states of loss, in an unhappy destiny, in perdition, in hell. 
诸比丘！同样的，如果恶戒者……生诸垢秽者抱着刹帝利少女……而卧，因此他便长时无利而受苦，身坏后，堕苦处恶趣恶界与地狱’”。
But if one who is unvirtuous, evil-natured … and full of corruption, should sit down or lie down embracing a warrior-noble maiden … that would be long for his harm and suffering: on the break-up of the body, after death, he would reappear in states of loss, in an unhappy destiny, in perdition, in hell” (A IV 128–29).

在《火聚喻》中业已显示受用有关女人的五欲的受苦，
157.Having thus shown by means of the analogy of the mass of fire the suffering that is bound up with women and has as its condition the indulgence of the five cords of sense desires [by the unvirtuous], 
尚有相似的说法：[此處的英譯見後。]
to the same intent he showed, by the following similes of the horse-hair rope, the sharp spear, the iron sheet, the iron ball, the iron bed, the iron chair, and the iron cauldron, the pain that has as its condition [acceptance of] homage and reverential salutation, and the use of robes, alms food, bed and chair, and dwelling [by unvirtuous bhikkhus]:
“诸比丘！若有强力男子，用坚固的发绳绞缠比丘的两胫而引擦，
“What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong horse-hair rope twisted round both legs by a strong man and tightened 
先破其皮，
so that it cut through the outer skin, 
次切深皮，
and having cut through the outer skin it cut through the inner skin, 
再切其肉，
and having cut through the inner skin it cut through the flesh, 
肉切而后切腱，
and having cut through the flesh it cut through the sinews, 
腱切而后切骨，
and having cut through the sinews it cut through the bones, 
直至伤害其髓而止；
and having cut through the bones it remained crushing the bone marrow—
或者受刹帝利大家、
or that he should consent to the homage of great warrior-nobles, 
或婆罗门大家
great brahmans, 
及长者大家的礼敬之乐，你们觉得那一种较好？……
great householders?” (A IV 129). [56]
诸比丘！若有强力男子，用锐利而油光的刀，刺入比丘的胸，
And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong man wound one’s breast with a sharp spear tempered in oil—
或者受刹帝利大家，
or that he should consent to the reverential salutation of great warrior-nobles, 
婆罗门大家
great brahmans, 
及长者大家的合掌之乐，你们觉得那一种较好？……
great householders?” (A IV 130).
诸比丘！若有强力男子，用热烈燃烧而光辉的铁板，包卷比丘之身，
And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one’s body should be wrapped by a strong man in a red-hot iron sheet burning, blazing and glowing— 
或者受用刹帝利
or that he should use robes given out of faith by great warrior-nobles, 
婆罗门
great brahmans, 
长者大家信施的衣服，你们觉得那一种较好？……
great householders?” (A IV 130–31).
诸比丘！若有强力男子，用热烈燃烧而光辉的铁叉，叉开他的口，
And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one’s mouth should be prised open by a strong man with red-hot iron tongs burning, blazing and glowing, 
继以热烈燃烧而光辉的铁丸投其口中，
and that into his mouth should be put a red-hot iron ball burning, blazing and glowing, 
烧掉他的唇
which burns his lips 
口
and burns his mouth 
舌
and tongue 
喉
and throat 
胃
and belly 
肠
and passes out below carrying with it his bowels 
及肠膜而后从下部出去，
and entrails—
或者受用刹帝利婆罗门长者大家信施的饮食，你们觉得那一样较好？
or that he should use alms food given out of faith by great warrior-nobles …?” (A IV 131–32).
诸比丘！若有强力男子，执他的头和躯干，
And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong man seize him by the head or seize him by the shoulders 
使坐或卧于热铁燃烧而光辉的铁椅或铁床，
and seat him or lay him on a red-hot iron bed or iron chair, burning, blazing and glowing—
或者受用刹帝利婆罗门长者大家信施的床椅，你们觉得那一种较好？……
or that he should use a bed or chair given out of faith by great warrior-nobles … ?” (A IV 132–33).
诸比丘！若有强力男子，执之而颠倒其首足，
And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong man take him feet up and head down 
投入热烈燃烧炽盛的大铁釜中，
and plunge him into a red-hot metal cauldron burning, blazing and glowing, 
使他在釜里时沉时浮或左或右的煎沸，
to be boiled there in a swirl of froth, and as he boils in the swirl of froth to be swept now up, now down, and now across—
或者受用刹帝利婆罗门长者大家信施的精舍，你们觉得那一种较好”？
or that he should use a dwelling given out of faith by great warrior-nobles … ?” (A IV 133–34).
这些发绳、利刀、铁板、铁丸、铁床、铁椅、大铁釜的譬喻，是显示恶戒者受用礼敬、合掌、衣服、饮食、床、椅、精舍等之苦。[此處的英譯見前。]

是故：沉溺于欲乐，破戒有何乐？结果无穷苦，过于抱火聚。
158. What pleasure has a man of broken virtue Forsaking not sense pleasures, which bear fruit Of pain more violent even than the pain In the embracing of a mass of fire?
虽受礼敬乐，破戒有何乐？彼因此受苦，过于引绳锯。
What pleasure has he in accepting homage Who, having failed in virtue, must partake Of pain that will excel in agony The crushing of his legs with horse-hair ropes? [57]
受信众合掌，无戒有何乐？彼因此受苦，过于利刀刺。
What pleasure has a man devoid of virtue Accepting salutations of the faithful, Which is the cause of pain acuter still Than pain produced by stabbing with a spear?
不自调御者，受用衣何乐？久受地狱苦，火焰铁板触。
What is the pleasure in the use of garments For one without restraint, whereby in hell He will for long be forced to undergo The contact of the blazing iron sheet?
无戒受美食，毒如哈罗哈，因此于长夜，吞咽热铁丸。
Although to him his alms food may seem tasty, Who has no virtue, it is direst poison, Because of which he surely will be made For long to swallow burning iron balls.
无戒用床座，虽苦思为乐，热铁椅与床，恼苦无穷极。
And when the virtueless make use of couches And chairs, though reckoned pleasing, it is pain Because they will be tortured long indeed On red-hot blazing iron beds and chairs.
信施寺中住，破戒有何乐？因此彼当住，热红大铁釜。
Then what delight is there for one unvirtuous Inhabiting a dwelling given in faith, Since for that reason he will have to dwell Shut up inside a blazing iron pan?
世间导师呵：“破戒如粪土，具恶有疑行，有漏而内腐”。
The Teacher of the world, in him condemning, Described him in these terms: “Of suspect habits, Full of corruption, lecherous as well, By nature evil, rotten too within.”
不御非沙门，但穿沙门服，善根自掘害，此生实卑恶。
So out upon the life of him abiding Without restraint, of him that wears the guise Of the ascetic that he will not be, And damages and undermines himself!
如欲庄严者，厌离粪与尸，寂静具戒者，弃彼命何如？
What is the life he leads, since any person, No matter who, with virtue to his credit Avoids it here, as those that would look well Keep far away from dung or from a corpse?
不离诸怖畏，却离诸证乐，
紧闭人天门，登临地狱道。
He is not free from any sort of terror, Though free enough from pleasure of attainment; While heaven’s door is bolted fast against him, He is well set upon the road to hell.
破戒者破戒，具足诸罪恶，悲愍者所愍，舍彼复谁属？
Who else if not one destitute of virtue More fit to be the object of compassion?  Many indeed and grave are the defects That brand a man neglectful of his virtue.

如是观察，便是见破戒的过患。
Seeing danger in the failure of virtue should be understood as reviewing in such ways as these. 


（二、具戒的功德）与上述相反的，为见具戒的功德。
And seeing benefits in perfected vir-tue should be understood in the opposite sense.

如次当知：
159. Furthermore: [58]
净戒无垢者，彼为人信乐，受持衣与钵，出家而有果。
His virtue is immaculate, His wearing of the bowl and robes Gives pleasure and inspires trust, His going forth will bear its fruit.
净戒比丘心，如暗不侵日，自责等怖畏，无从而潜入。
A bhikkhu in his virtue pure Has never fear that self-reproach Will enter in his heart: indeed There is no darkness in the sun.
比丘戒成就，苦行林光耀，犹如盛满月，高悬虚空照。
A bhikkhu in his virtue bright Shines forth in the Ascetics’ Wood As by the brightness of his beams The moon lights up the firmament.
具戒之比丘，身香亦可喜，甚至诸天悦；戒香何须说？
Now, if the bodily perfume Of virtuous bhikkhus can succeed In pleasing even deities, What of the perfume of his virtue?
一切诸香中，戒香最为胜，此香熏十方，而无有障碍。
It is more perfect far than all The other perfumes in the world, Because the perfume virtue gives Is borne unchecked in all directions.
奉侍具戒者，作少而果大，故以彼为器，供养与恭敬。
The deeds done for a virtuous man, Though they be few, will bear much fruit, And so the virtuous man becomes A vessel of honour and renown.
具戒于今世，不为诸漏害，他世诸苦根，因缘亦断绝。
There are no cankers here and now To plague the virtuous man at all; The virtuous man digs out the root Of suffering in lives to come.
不论人间福，以及诸天福，具戒者有愿，实非难得事。
Perfection among human kind And even among deities.  If wished for, is not hard to gain For him whose virtue is perfected;
诸戒成就者，彼心常追逐：无上涅槃德，究竟寂静乐。
But once his virtue is perfected, His mind then seeks no other kind han the perfection of Nibbaana, The state where utter peace prevails.
诸乐根本戒，此中多行相，种种诸功德，智者应辨别。
Such is the blessed fruit of virtue, Showing full many a varied form, So let a wise man know it well This root of all perfection’s branches.

若能如是辨别则意志倾向于戒的成就而畏于破戒了。
160. The mind of one who understands thus, shudders at failure in virtue and reaches out towards the perfecting of virtue. 
是故应见前述破戒的过患及具戒的功德，以一切恭敬而严净诸戒。
So virtue should be cleansed with all care, seeing this danger of failure in virtue and this benefit of the perfection of virtue in the way stated.

在“住戒有慧人”的偈颂中，以戒定慧三门显示清净之道，至此先已解说戒门。
161.And at this point in the Path of Purification, which is shown under the headings of virtue, concentration and understanding by the stanza, “When a wise man, established well in virtue” (§1), virtue, firstly, has been fully illustrated.


为诸善人所喜悦而造的清净道论，完成了第一品，定名为戒的解释。
The first chapter called “The Description of Virtue” in the Path of Purification composed for the purpose of gladdening good people.
清净道论
The Path of Purification
觉音造
buddhaghosa
~Naa.namoli比丘英译

Tattha:

（十三头陀支的语义）先说“语义”：
23. Tattha atthatoti
（一）置于道路墓冢垃圾堆等任何尘土之上的，并在（比丘的）穿着的意义上正如尘堆在他们的身上，故名粪扫衣（尘堆衣）；
taava rathikasusaana-sa^nkaara-kuu.ta-aadiina.m yattha katthaci-pa.msuuna.m upari.thitattaa abbhuggata.t.thena tesu tesu pa.msukuulamivaati pa.msukuula.m,
或者被视如尘土一样可厌的状态为粪扫衣--这是指到达可厌的状态而说的。
atha vaa pa.msu viya kucchita-bhaava.m ulatiiti pa.msukuula.m, kucchita-bhaava.m gacchatiiti vutta.m hoti/
如是在粪扫衣的语原上说，有着粪扫衣的意思。
Eva.m laddhanibbacanassa pa.msukuulassa dhaara.na.m pa.msukuula.m, ta.m siilamassaati pa.msukuuliko/
有着（粪扫衣）的习惯者为粪扫衣者。
Pa.msukuulikassaa^nga.m pa.msukuulika^nga.m/
粪扫衣者的支分为“粪扫衣支”。
A^nganti kaara.na.m vuccati/
支分为原因。故知（支分）与（粪扫衣者的原因）由于受持（的思）而成粪扫衣者是同义的。
Tasmaa yena samaadaa-nena so pa.msukuuliko hoti, tasseta.m adhivacananti veditabba.m/

（二）与前类似的解释，僧伽梨（重复衣），郁多罗僧（上衣），安陀会（下衣），称为三衣，有着持三衣的习惯者为三衣者。
Eteneva nayena sa^nghaa.ti-uttaraasa^nga-antaravaasaka-sa^nkhaata.m ti-ciivara.msiilamassaati te-ciivariko/
三衣者的支分为“三衣支”。
Te-ciivarikassa a^nga.m te-ciivarika^nga.m/

（三）称为施食的团食落下为乞食，即他人所施的团食集于钵中的意思。
Bhikkhaa-sa^nkhaataana.m pana aamisa-pi.n.daana.m paatoti pi.n.da-paato, parehi dinnaana.m pi.n.daana.m patte nipatananti vutta.m hoti/
到各户人家去求食者为乞食者；
Ta.m pi.n.da-paata.mu~nchati ta.m ta.m kula.m upasa^nkamanto gavesatiiti pi.n.dapaatiko/
或誓愿行乞团食者为乞食者。
Pi.n.daaya vaapatitu.m vatametassaati pi.n.dapaatii,
行即是走。乞食者即乞食的人。
patitunti caritu.m, pi.n.da-paatii eva pi.n.da-paatiko/
他的支分为“常乞食支”。
Pi.n.dapaatikassa a^nga.m pi.n.dapaatika^nga.m/

（四）切断为分割，离切断为不断，即不分割之意。
Daana.m vuccati avakha.n.dana.m, apeta.m daanatoti apadaana.m, anavakha.n.da-nanti attho/
与不断共为有不断，即随每家不分割之意。
Saha apadaanena sapadaana.m, avakha.n.danarahita.m anugharantivutta.m hoti/
